title: The Power of Meta Access in the Software of the Future --- Demonstrated on LLM Chat UIs and Chat AI
title_zh: 元访问在未来软件中的力量——以LLM聊天界面与Chat AI为例进行验证

paragraphs.en: Chat remains the default surface for many large language model (LLM) tasks, even as agentic tools such as OpenCode excel at coding and automation. Yet the model sees the current dialogue but not the workspace around it. We explore meta access—giving the assistant a structured, permissioned view of the interface itself and propose a ladder of levels: feature tutoring; metadata, settings, and preference access; retrieval over summaries and messages, confirmed mutation, and full orchestration. Meta access can turn a chat client from many screens into one entry point for finding, navigating, organising, and operating it, while raising risks around grounding, privacy, prompt injection, and trust. General-purpose agentic harnesses are runtimes; because they can change their own settings, meta access becomes reflexive and needs a separate control-plane boundary. We ground this in the Meta Chat prototype of the Chat AI client. It builds bounded context from, e.g., summaries, settings, and relevant messages; links references to conversations, topics, and personas; supports confirmed, reversible changes; offers a browsable tutorial library; and recommends personas as user-started conversations. By exposing application state in structured form, meta access can extend screen readers from widget descriptions to semantic workspace operations. Meta access thus turns chat from a window onto one conversation into a control layer for the whole workspace, extending chat toward agentic capability without surrendering user control. As assistants become embedded in IDEs, dashboards, office suites, and operating systems, AI-era interfaces should expose a structured, permissioned model of their state and capabilities, ideally by opening their existing metamodels through a debugger-like interface.
paragraphs.zh: 聊天仍然是许多大语言模型（LLM）任务的默认界面，即使像 OpenCode 这样的智能体工具在编程和自动化方面表现出色。 然而模型只能看到当前对话，却看不到其周围的工作区。 我们探索元访问——让智能体获得对界面本身的结构化、经许可的视图，并提出一个层级阶梯：功能引导；元数据、设置与偏好访问；对摘要和消息的检索、经确认的变更以及完全编排。 元访问可以把聊天客户端从众多屏幕变成查找、导航、组织和操作该客户端的单一入口，同时也带来关于接地、隐私、提示注入和信任的风险。 通用智能体框架本质上是运行时；由于它们能够更改自身设置，元访问就变成自反性的，需要一个独立的控制平面边界。 我们以 Chat AI 客户端的 Meta Chat 原型为基础来落实这一构想。 它从摘要、设置和相关消息等构建有界上下文；将引用链接到对话、主题和角色；支持经确认且可撤销的更改；提供可浏览的教程库；并以用户发起的对话形式推荐角色。 通过以结构化形式暴露应用状态，元访问可以将屏幕阅读器从部件描述扩展到语义化的工作区操作。 因此，元访问使聊天从面向单个对话的窗口转变为整个工作区的控制层，在向智能体能力延伸的同时不放弃用户控制。 随着智能体被嵌入 IDE、仪表盘、办公套件和操作系统中，AI 时代的界面应当暴露其状态和能力的结构化、经许可的模型，理想做法是通过类似调试器的接口开放其已有的元模型。

paragraphs.en: The chat interface has been the default surface for interacting with large language models, and it remains the most common one for many day-to-day tasks: drafting, search, planning, learning, and personal assistance. In parallel, a second interaction model has matured. Agentic tools such as OpenCode [ 17 ] operate in a terminal or editor, call tools, and carry out multi-step tasks on external environments; they have become a natural choice for much software work. The two models are complementary rather than substitutes. Agents excel when the task is to operate on an environment, while chat UIs remain the natural surface when the user wants to ask, compare, plan, draft, or re-find something, and when the conversation itself is the workspace.
paragraphs.zh: 聊天界面一直是大语言模型交互的默认界面，对许多日常任务而言它仍是最常用的方式：起草、搜索、规划、学习和个人助理。 与此同时，第二种交互模式也已成熟。 诸如 OpenCode [ 17 ] 这类智能体工具在终端或编辑器中运行、调用工具，并在外部环境上执行多步骤任务；它们已成为许多软件工作的自然选择。 这两种模式是互补的，而非相互替代。 当任务是在某个环境上进行操作时，智能体表现出色；而当用户想要提问、比较、规划、起草或重新查找某样东西，以及当对话本身就是工作空间时，聊天界面仍是自然的界面。

paragraphs.en: The deeper claim of this paper is architectural rather than conversational. Chat is the first surface on which meta access is practical, but the pattern is not specific to chat. An emerging AI-era interface is one in which an assistant is embedded in the application rather than confined to a separate chat window, and in which the assistant can reason over the application’s own model of its state and capabilities. Whether the surface is a chat client, an IDE, a spreadsheet, a dashboard, or an operating system, the same asymmetry appears: the assistant sees the current task but not the workspace that contains it. Meta access is the missing contract between the two. The contrast is sharpest for general-purpose agentic harnesses such as OpenCode, which are runtimes rather than applications with a fixed purpose, and which can change the configuration that governs their own tools and permissions (Section 4.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 本文更深层的论点是架构层面的，而非对话层面的。 聊天是元访问在实践中首个可行的界面，但这一模式并不局限于聊天。 一种正在兴起的人工智能时代界面是：助手被嵌入应用程序之中，而非被局限于一个单独的聊天窗口，并且助手能够基于应用程序自身对状态和能力的模型进行推理。 无论界面是聊天客户端、IDE、电子表格、仪表盘还是操作系统，同样的不对称性都会出现：助手看到的是当前任务，却看不到包含该任务的工作区。 元访问正是这两者之间缺失的契约。 这种对比对于通用智能体框架（如 OpenCode）而言最为鲜明：它们是运行时环境，而非具有固定用途的应用程序，并且可以更改支配其自身工具与权限的配置（见 4.6 节）。

paragraphs.en: In applications such as Chat AI [ 7 ] , that workspace is larger than the current conversation: a sidebar of past conversations, user-defined topics, model selection, attachments, memories, settings, a persona library, and feature-specific controls. The model, however, usually sees only the current conversation plus a system prompt. Everything that makes the workspace a workspace—what else the user has discussed, how their chats are organised, which features exist and where they live—is outside the model’s view.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Chat AI [ 7 ] 等应用中，该工作区比当前对话更大：包括历史对话侧边栏、用户自定义主题、模型选择、附件、记忆、设置、角色库以及特定功能的控件。 然而，模型通常只能看到当前对话加上系统提示词。 所有让工作区成为工作区的东西——用户还讨论过什么、他们的聊天如何组织、存在哪些功能以及它们位于何处——都在模型的视野之外。

paragraphs.en: This asymmetry creates a practical problem. As a user’s history grows, the interface becomes harder to navigate: finding a conversation about a past decision, remembering which topic contains it, or learning a rarely used feature requires manual scanning. Conventional search helps with known-item retrieval, but users often ask questions that are relational or procedural: “Where is my food-order chat?” , “Which topic holds the notes from the interview?” , “How do I attach a file?” . These are questions about the interface and its contents, not about the world.
paragraphs.zh: 这种不对称性带来了一个实际的问题。 随着用户的历史记录不断增长，界面变得越来越难以导航：要找到关于过去某个决策的对话、记住某个话题包含哪些内容，或者学习一个很少使用的功能，都需要手动翻找。 传统搜索有助于查找已知的目标，但用户提出的问题往往是关系型或操作型的：“我点餐的聊天在哪里？”，“哪个话题里有面试记录？”，“我怎么附加文件？”。 这些是关于界面及其内容的问题，而不是关于外部世界的问题。

paragraphs.en: We use the term meta access for an assistant’s structured access to the interface that hosts it: it may access and potentially alter information about the interface and any of the user’s data. Meta access is related to, but distinct from, retrieval-augmented generation over documents [ 13 ] and tool use by language models [ 31 , 24 ] . The object of retrieval is the user’s own workspace state; the object of action is the interface itself. Meta access therefore sits at the intersection of conversational search, command palettes, recommender-style navigation, and agentic tool use.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用「元访问」一词来指代智能体对其所依托界面的结构化访问：智能体可以访问并可能更改关于该界面的信息以及用户的任何数据。 元访问与基于文档的检索增强生成 [ 13 ] 以及语言模型的工具使用 [ 31 , 24 ] 相关，但又有所区别。 检索的对象是用户自己的工作区状态；操作的对象则是界面本身。 因此，元访问处于对话式搜索、命令面板、推荐式导航以及智能体工具使用的交汇点上。

paragraphs.en: The prefix meta comes from Greek and denotes a level that is about, beyond, or refers to another level. Metadata is data about data; a metamodel is a model that describes the concepts and relations of another model; metacommunication is communication about communication. In each case, the meta-level does not replace the object level. It describes it, constrains it, or acts on it.
paragraphs.zh: 前缀 meta 源自希腊语，表示一个关于、超越或指向另一层次的层次。 元数据是关于数据的数据；元模型是描述另一个模型的概念与关系的模型；元交流是关于交流的交流。 在每一种情况下，元层次都不会取代对象层次。 它描述对象层次、约束对象层次，或对其施加作用。

paragraphs.en: A chatbot normally operates at the object level: it talks about the user’s task, the world, or the content of the current conversation. Meta access adds a meta-level whose object is the chat application itself. The assistant reasons about conversations, topics, memories, features, and settings rather than only about the subject of the dialogue. Its context is not the full interface but a workspace model: a structured description of the entities the interface exposes (chats, topics, features, preferences), ideally derived from the application’s own metamodel, and, eventually, the operations that can be requested on them. This is the sense in which the prototype has a metamodel-like view. It does not reproduce the interface; it uses an abstraction of the interface’s concepts and capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 聊天机器人通常在对象层面运作：它谈论的是用户的任务、外部世界或当前对话的内容。 元访问增加了一个元层面，其对象是聊天应用本身。 助手推理的对象是会话、话题、记忆、功能与设置，而不仅仅是对话的主题。 它的上下文不是完整的界面，而是一个工作区模型：对界面所暴露的实体（会话、话题、功能、偏好）的结构化描述，理想情况下源自应用自身的元模型，并最终包括可对这些实体请求执行的操作。 这就是该原型具有类似元模型视图的含义。 它并不复现界面，而是使用界面概念与能力的一种抽象。

sents.en: Its context is not the full interface but a workspace model: a structured description of the entities the interface exposes (chats, topics, features, preferences), ideally derived from the application’s own metamodel, and, eventually, the operations that can be requested on them.
sents.zh: 它的上下文不是完整的界面，而是一个工作区模型：对界面所暴露的实体（会话、话题、功能、偏好）的结构化描述，理想情况下源自应用自身的元模型，并最终包括可对这些实体请求执行的操作。

sents.en: This is the sense in which the prototype has a metamodel-like view.
sents.zh: 这就是该原型具有类似元模型视图的含义。

sents.en: It does not reproduce the interface; it uses an abstraction of the interface’s concepts and capabilities.
sents.zh: 它并不复现界面，而是使用界面概念与能力的一种抽象。

paragraphs.en: At the scale of a whole application, this abstraction is an application metamodel: a description of the application’s entities, relations, and operations. Many applications already have such a model internally—a document model in an editor, a project and syntax model in an IDE, a schema in a database, a scene graph in a graphics tool—and debugging or profiling interfaces already expose parts of it in a controlled way. Meta access can reuse these models rather than relying on pixels or ad hoc scraping. The design question is which parts of the metamodel to expose, at what level of stability and permission, and how to map them into a capability layer that works across applications.
paragraphs.zh: 在整个应用程序的尺度上，这种抽象就是一个应用元模型：对应用中实体、关系和操作的描述。 许多应用内部已经有这样的模型——编辑器中的文档模型、IDE 中的项目与语法模型、数据库中的模式（schema）、图形工具中的场景图——而调试或性能分析接口已经以受控的方式暴露了其中一部分。 元访问可以复用这些模型，而不必依赖像素或临时的抓取手段。 设计问题在于：暴露元模型的哪些部分、以怎样的稳定性和权限级别，以及如何将它们映射到一个能够跨应用工作的能力层。

paragraphs.en: The distinction separates three things that are easy to confuse. Metadata access is the narrowest form of meta access: it reads descriptive fields such as titles, topics, and timestamps. Meta-level knowledge also includes the feature catalogue, the persona catalogue, and current preference values, which describe the application rather than a single conversation. Meta-level action goes further and changes the object level, for example by moving a chat or changing a memory setting. The ladder in Section 4 follows this progression from describing the interface, to reading its state, to acting on it.
paragraphs.zh: 这一区分将三种容易混淆的事物分离开来。 元数据访问是最窄的元访问形式：它读取标题、话题和时间戳等描述性字段。 元层知识还包括特征目录、画像目录以及当前偏好值，它们描述的是应用程序本身而非单次对话。 元层行动更进一步，会改变对象层，例如移动一个会话或更改记忆设置。 第 4 节中的阶梯正遵循了这一递进过程：从描述界面，到读取其状态，再到对其采取行动。

sents.en: This paper is a position paper grounded in an existing implementation.

sents.en: We make five contributions:

paragraphs.en: We present a ladder of meta-access levels that separates feature tutoring, metadata, settings, and preference access, summary and message-level retrieval, confirmed mutating actions, and full orchestration, and report how far the implemented prototype reaches on that ladder.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种元访问级别的阶梯，将功能教学、元数据、设置与偏好访问、摘要与消息级检索、经确认的变更操作以及完整的编排分离开来，并报告了所实现的原型在该阶梯上达到了哪一级。

paragraphs.en: We propose meta access as a general design requirement for AI-era interfaces, not only chat clients, and show how the ladder, capability model, and guardrails transfer to other stateful applications and to general-purpose agentic harnesses, whose self-configuration adds a separate control-plane problem.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出元访问（meta access）作为 AI 时代界面（不仅是聊天客户端）的一项通用设计要求，并展示阶梯模型、能力模型与防护栏如何迁移到其他有状态应用以及通用智能体框架（agentic harnesses）中——后者的自我配置还带来一个单独的控制平面问题。

paragraphs.en: We articulate the opportunities of using a chat interface as a first access layer for the whole interface, with search and navigation as the first concrete use cases, and define guardrail contracts that tie each capability to its evidence, scope, target validation, disclosure, confirmation, and failure behaviour.
paragraphs.zh: 我们阐述了将聊天界面作为整个界面的首个访问层的机会，其中搜索和导航是首批具体用例，并定义了护栏契约，将每项能力与其证据、范围、目标验证、披露、确认及失败行为绑定起来。

paragraphs.en: We outline risks and an evaluation agenda for measuring whether meta access actually helps users.
paragraphs.zh: 我们概述了衡量元访问是否真正帮助用户的风险与评估议程。

paragraphs.en: We present the Meta Chat prototype in the Chat AI client as a demonstrator of these opportunities and design choices.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 Chat AI 客户端中展示 Meta Chat 原型，作为这些机遇与设计选择的演示。

paragraphs.en: Meta access draws on several literatures that rarely meet: conversational search and personal re-finding; LLM agents, tool use, and interface automation; retrieval, memory, and context; and mixed-initiative interaction, security, and human factors. We review them in these groups, compare representative work along nine dimensions, and then position the present work relative to them.
paragraphs.zh: 元访问借鉴了几类鲜有交汇的研究文献：会话式搜索与个人化重新查找；大语言模型智能体、工具使用与界面自动化；检索、记忆与上下文；以及混合主动式交互、安全性与人因因素。 我们按这些类别对相关文献进行综述，沿九个维度比较代表性工作，然后将本文工作置于其中加以定位。

paragraphs.en: Information retrieval has long treated dialogue as an interface to a search system. Radlinski and Craswell [ 22 ] frame conversational search as a multi-turn collaboration in which system and user clarify an information need, retrieve results, and interpret them; Trippas et al. [ 25 ] derive design implications from spoken conversational search, and Zamani et al. [ 32 ] survey the field’s shift from ad hoc retrieval to interactive problem solving. This work supplies the interaction vocabulary that meta access inherits: clarification, follow-up queries, mixed initiative, and results that support both answer and exploration. Its usual target, however, is an external collection such as the web or a document corpus, and classical lexical retrieval, including BM25 and its descendants [ 23 ] , remains a strong baseline for known-item search.
paragraphs.zh: 信息检索长期以来将对话视为搜索系统的一种界面。 Radlinski 和 Craswell [ 22 ] 将会话式搜索界定为一种多轮协作，系统和用户在其中澄清信息需求、检索结果并对其进行解读；Trippas 等人 [ 25 ] 从口语会话式搜索中推导出设计启示，而 Zamani 等人 [ 32 ] 则综述了该领域从临时检索到交互式问题求解的转变。 这项工作提供了元访问所继承的交互词汇：澄清、后续查询、混合主动权，以及同时支持回答与探索的结果。 然而，其通常的检索对象是诸如网络或文档语料库之类的外部集合，而且包括 BM25 及其后继方法 [ 23 ] 在内的经典词法检索，对于已知条目搜索而言仍然是一个强有力的基线。

paragraphs.en: Personal information management (PIM) studies how people keep, organise, and re-find their own digital material. Whittaker [ 27 ] frames PIM as a shift from consumption to curation, and Dumais et al. [ 8 ] show that a unified index over email, files, and web pages, combined with contextual cues such as time and authorship, supports re-finding; users often remember context rather than exact content, and search and browsing are complementary. A chat workspace has the same character: it is small enough to browse but grows large enough to need search, and its items carry rich contextual metadata. Meta access is a conversational form of re-finding over that collection. The prototype uses titles, topics, and recency as metadata cues, summaries as compressed content, and local lexical search over message text for content questions, bringing it closer to full-text PIM systems such as “Stuff I’ve Seen” while retaining an interface-aware layer.
paragraphs.zh: 个人信息管理（PIM）研究人们如何保存、整理和重新找到自己的数字资料。 Whittaker [ 27 ] 将 PIM 视为从消费到策展的转变，Dumais 等人 [ 8 ] 的研究表明，在电子邮件、文件和网页之上建立统一索引，并结合时间、作者等上下文线索，能够支持重新查找；用户往往记住的是上下文而非确切内容，且搜索与浏览互为补充。 聊天工作区具有同样的特征：它小到可以浏览，又会增长到需要搜索的规模，且其中的条目带有丰富的上下文元数据。 元访问是对该集合进行重新查找的一种对话式形式。 该原型使用标题、主题和时效性作为元数据线索，使用摘要作为压缩内容，并针对内容问题对消息文本进行本地词法搜索，这使其更接近诸如「Stuff I've Seen」之类的全文 PIM 系统，同时保留了界面感知层。

ReAct [ 31 ] , Toolformer [ 24 ] , and Gorilla [ 20 ] show that language models can interleave reasoning with calls to external tools, although surveys and benchmarks document persistent weaknesses in planning, reliability, and generalisation [ 29 , 15 ] . paragraphs.en: OpenCode is a general-purpose agentic harness rather than an application with a specific purpose. It runs in the terminal, an IDE, or a desktop application, supports arbitrary models and tools, and keeps its behaviour in editable configuration [ 17 ] . Its workspace is whatever task it is given, usually repositories, shells, or editors, and its control plane includes prompts, tool and server registries, permission policies, hooks, and subagents. This generality matters for meta access: there is no single application metamodel to expose, and if the harness can read or change its own configuration, the assistant may alter the capability layer that is supposed to constrain it. We call this reflexive meta access and treat it separately in Section 4.6 . The Model Context Protocol (MCP) makes this control plane concrete. Hou et al. The environment is the hosting application, the observations are typed metadata rather than pixels, and the available actions can be declared explicitly instead of inferred from a GUI. paragraphs.en: Because a workspace can exceed any context window, meta access depends on how the interface is compressed. Retrieval-augmented generation [ 13 , 10 ] supplies the pattern of retrieving evidence before generating an answer. MemGPT [ 18 ] treats an LLM as an operating system with hierarchical memory; Generative Agents [ 19 ] maintain a memory stream with reflection; and LongMemEval [ 28 ] benchmarks long-term interactive memory. Long-context models are not a substitute: they can underuse information in the middle of a long prompt [ 14 ] , and BEAM [ 38 ] shows that even million-token models struggle as dialogues lengthen. MemoryAgentBench [ 39 ] finds that current memory agents do not master accurate retrieval, test-time learning, long-range understanding, and selective forgetting; LOCOMO-CONV [ 40 ] shows that conversational framing exposes retrieval gaps that QA-style benchmarks miss; and MemUse [ 41 ] reports a retrieval–integration gap in a four-month deployment. Together these results argue for a tiered index, query rewriting, implicit-intent handling, and integration-aware evaluation rather than benchmark accuracy alone.
paragraphs.zh: 由于工作区可能超出任何上下文窗口，元访问取决于接口如何被压缩。 检索增强生成 [ 13 , 10 ] 提供了在生成答案之前先检索证据的模式。 MemGPT [ 18 ] 将大语言模型视为具有分层记忆的操作系统；生成式智能体 [ 19 ] 维护带有反思机制的记忆流；LongMemEval [ 28 ] 则对长期交互记忆进行基准测试。 长上下文模型并不能替代记忆机制：它们可能无法充分利用长提示词中间的信息 [ 14 ] ，而且 BEAM [ 38 ] 表明，即使是百万级词元的模型，在对话变长时也会捉襟见肘。 MemoryAgentBench [ 39 ] 发现，当前的智能体并未掌握准确检索、测试时学习、长程理解和选择性遗忘；LOCOMO-CONV [ 40 ] 表明，对话式的表述会暴露出问答式基准测试所忽略的检索缺口；MemUse [ 41 ] 则在为期四个月的部署中报告了检索—整合之间的差距。 这些结果共同表明，我们需要分层的索引、查询改写、隐式意图处理以及注重整合的评估，而不仅仅是基准测试的准确率。

paragraphs.en: Conversation summarisation provides one practical compression mechanism. Surveys of dialogue summarisation [ 9 ] describe methods for condensing multi-turn interactions while preserving salient content. The meta chat uses such summaries together with topics, memories, and per-chat settings; it adds selective lexical message excerpts when a question needs content. This keeps cost bounded and reduces exposure compared with shipping full histories, but summaries are lossy and can be stale, and lexical retrieval depends on the message wording. Recent memory work makes provenance explicit: Lu et al. [ 56 ] use message-level evidence chains and propose–verify–commit writes with revision history, a structured counterpart of confirmed memory mutations and conditional undo. Hierarchical, hybrid, and semantic retrieval are the natural next steps.
paragraphs.zh: 对话摘要提供了一种实用的压缩机制。 关于对话摘要的综述 [ 9 ] 描述了在保留重要内容的同时压缩多轮交互的方法。 元聊天将此类摘要与话题、记忆以及每个聊天的设置结合使用；当问题需要具体内容时，它会附加选择性的词汇级消息摘录。 与传输完整历史记录相比，这控制了成本并减少了暴露，但摘要是有损的且可能过时，而词汇检索依赖于消息的措辞。 近期的记忆工作明确了来源：Lu 等人 [ 56 ] 使用消息级证据链，并提出–验证–提交的写入方式及修订历史，这是已确认记忆变更和条件撤销的结构化对应物。 分层检索、混合检索和语义检索是自然的后续方向。

paragraphs.en: Meta access should not be a one-shot command interpreter. Horvitz [ 12 ] sets out principles for mixed-initiative interfaces, including reasoning about uncertainty, the user’s goals, and the cost of asking versus acting; Allen et al. [ 1 ] discuss the dialogue-management challenges, and Amershi et al. [ 2 ] distill widely used guidelines for human–AI interaction. Studies of LLM use reinforce the need for guidance and verification: non-experts struggle to design prompts [ 33 ] , users of code-generation tools inspect and iterate on model output [ 26 , 4 ] , and natural-language database interfaces documented ambiguity and robustness problems long before LLMs [ 3 ] . Laban et al. [ 37 ] add a multi-turn caution: tested LLMs perform worse in multi-turn than single-turn conversations, often commit to assumptions early, and fail to recover, which makes explicit state and clarification design requirements. Human-factors studies reinforce this: Schneider et al. [ 46 ] document linguistic patterns and breakdowns in a retrieval-augmented assistant, Yu et al. [ 49 ] find no learning advantage over search when user characteristics are considered, and Jerry et al. [ 48 ] propose a model-based approach to LLM-driven accessible interfaces. Together they suggest that chat should complement, not replace, the visual interface, and that meta access must be judged by user outcomes and breakdowns.
paragraphs.zh: 元访问不应当是一次性的命令解释器。 Horvitz [ 12 ] 提出了混合主动式界面的原则，包括对不确定性、用户目标以及询问与行动之间成本的推理；Allen 等人 [ 1 ] 讨论了对话管理的挑战，Amershi 等人 [ 2 ] 提炼了广泛使用的人机（人类与 AI）交互准则。 关于 LLM 使用的研究强化了对引导和验证的需求：非专家难以设计提示词 [ 33 ]，代码生成工具的用户会检查并迭代模型输出 [ 26 , 4 ]，而自然语言数据库接口早在 LLM 出现之前就记录了歧义和鲁棒性问题 [ 3 ]。Laban 等人 [ 37 ] 补充了一项关于多轮对话的警示：经测试的 LLM 在多轮对话中的表现不如单轮对话，往往过早地做出假设且无法恢复，这使得显式状态和澄清成为设计上的必要要求。 人因学研究也强化了这一点：Schneider 等人 [ 46 ] 记录了一个检索增强助手中的语言模式与失效情况，Yu 等人 [ 49 ] 发现在考虑用户特征时，相比搜索并无学习优势，而 Jerry 等人 [ 48 ] 提出了一种基于模型的方法来构建由 LLM 驱动的无障碍界面。 它们共同表明，聊天应当是对可视化界面的补充而非替代，并且元访问必须以用户结果和失效情况来评判。

paragraphs.en: Any assistant that reads user content and can act on the user’s behalf is a security boundary. Prompt injection [ 21 ] and indirect prompt injection [ 11 ] show that untrusted retrieved text can redirect a model’s behaviour; AgentDojo [ 5 ] benchmarks these attacks and defences in tool-using agents, and StepJack [ 43 ] shows that indirect injection can be decomposed into innocuous steps across a navigation path. CaMeL [ 53 ] separates control flow from data flow and enforces capability checks on data flows, while ClawGuard [ 55 ] enforces a user-confirmed rule set at each tool-call boundary. AC4A [ 52 ] turns this into access control: instead of all-or-nothing access to an API or page, an agent receives permissions over specific resources and actions. AIOS [ 50 ] places scheduling, memory, storage, access control, and isolation in an operating-system-like kernel, moving resource governance from prompts to the platform. PrivacyBench [ 45 ] benchmarks privacy in personalised AI, and Wang et al. [ 44 ] identify irrelevant personalisation, preference narrowing, and sycophancy as side effects of conditioning on conversation history.
paragraphs.zh: 任何读取用户内容并能代表用户执行操作的助手都是一个安全边界。 提示注入[21]与间接提示注入[11]表明，不可信的检索文本可以改变模型的行为；AgentDojo[5]在使用工具的智能体中对这些攻击与防御进行了基准测试，而StepJack[43]表明间接注入可以被分解为沿导航路径的多个无害步骤。 CaMeL[53]将控制流与数据流分离，并对数据流实施能力检查，而ClawGuard[55]在每次工具调用边界处强制执行需用户确认的规则集。 AC4A[52]将其转化为访问控制：智能体不再获得对某个API或页面的全有或全无式访问，而是获得针对特定资源和操作的权限。 AIOS[50]将调度、内存、存储、访问控制和隔离置于一个类操作系统的内核中，把资源治理从提示层面转移到平台层面。 PrivacyBench[45]对个性化AI中的隐私问题进行了基准测试，而Wang等人 [44]将与对话历史条件化相关的副作用归纳为无关个性化、偏好窄化和谄媚行为。

paragraphs.en: The implication for meta access is that retrieved content must be treated as data rather than instructions, tools must be scoped to the user’s intent, and mutations should require confirmation. Privacy is the other side of the boundary. Meta access sends titles, topics, summaries, and memories to a model endpoint. This is less exposing than sending full message histories, but it is not anonymous: summaries and titles can reveal sensitive context. The local-first design of the host client, in which conversations live in the browser’s indexed database, is a useful starting point, but the boundary between local state and remote inference must be made explicit to users.
paragraphs.zh: 对元访问的启示是：检索到的内容必须被视为数据而非指令，工具的范围必须限定在用户意图之内，而修改操作应当要求确认。 隐私是边界的另一面。 元访问会将标题、话题、摘要和记忆发送到模型端点。 这比发送完整的消息历史暴露得更少，但它并非匿名：摘要和标题可能泄露敏感的上下文。 宿主客户端的本地优先设计——即对话保存在浏览器的索引数据库中——是一个有用的起点，但本地状态与远程推理之间的边界必须向用户明确说明。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 compares representative related work along nine dimensions that matter for meta access. The aim is not to rank papers but to locate the gap that meta access addresses. We use three values: + means the dimension is explicit and central to the paper; 0 means it is partial, indirect, or limited to a narrow setting; - means it is not addressed or is out of scope. The ratings describe each paper’s stated scope, not the quality of its contribution.

paragraphs.en: Three patterns stand out. First, conversational search and PIM occupy opposite corners: conversational search supports dialogue and content retrieval but not the user’s personal workspace, while PIM supports personal metadata and content but not dialogue or interface actions. Second, agent and GUI-automation work supports actions and interface operation, but its object is an open environment rather than the user’s own conversation history; personal scope, structured workspace metadata, and user-facing grounding are typically absent. Third, memory and long-context work supports dialogue and personal context, but it rarely models the interface or provides a capability layer for acting on it.
paragraphs.zh: 三种模式尤为突出。 首先，对话式搜索与个人信息管理（PIM）处于相反的两端：对话式搜索支持对话与内容检索，但不支持用户的个人工作区；而 PIM 支持个人元数据与内容，但不支持对话或界面操作。 其次，智能体与 GUI 自动化方面的工作支持动作与界面操作，但其作用对象是开放环境而非用户自身的对话历史；个人范围、结构化的工作区元数据以及面向用户的依据支撑通常都是缺失的。 最后，记忆与长上下文方面的工作支持对话与个人上下文，但它们很少对界面进行建模，也未提供在其上执行操作的能力层。

paragraphs.en: A trade-off is also visible: many systems that act do not expose citations to the underlying workspace items, while systems with strong grounding often do not act. Security work supplies adversarial benchmarks and defences but is rarely integrated with personal retrieval or interface help, and HCI work supplies interaction principles but not a concrete architecture. Meta access is the region that remains sparsely populated: personal scope, structured metadata, interface awareness, and grounding. The prototype now adds selective message-level retrieval and confirmed, reversible mutations, while the ladder in Section 4 makes the remaining boundaries explicit: hierarchical retrieval, broader level-4 actions, durable audit, and level-5 orchestration.
paragraphs.zh: 权衡也清晰可见：许多具备行动能力的系统不会暴露对底层工作区条目的引用，而具有强接地能力的系统往往不具备行动能力。 安全方面的工作提供了对抗性基准测试和防御手段，但很少与个人检索或界面辅助相整合；人机交互（HCI）方面的工作提供了交互原则，却没有给出具体的架构。 元数据访问是仍然相对空白的领域：个人范围、结构化元数据、界面感知以及接地能力。 该原型现已加入选择性消息级检索以及经过确认、可回滚的变更操作，而第 4 节中的阶梯模型明确了剩余的边界：分层检索、更广泛的第 4 级行动、持久审计以及第 5 级编排。

paragraphs.en: Existing work covers conversational search over external corpora, personal re-finding over files and email, and tool-using agents on web pages or operating systems. Meta access sits between these lines: the object of retrieval is the application’s own state, and the environment is a declared capability layer rather than an open GUI. The contribution of this paper is to name that combination, demonstrate it with confirmed, reversible actions, propose a ladder from tutoring to orchestration, and set out an evaluation agenda.
paragraphs.zh: 现有工作涵盖基于外部语料的对话式检索、基于文件和邮件的个人化重新查找，以及网页或操作系统上使用工具的智能体。 元访问介于这些方向之间：检索的对象是应用自身的状态，而环境是一个声明式的能力层，而非开放的图形界面。 本文的贡献在于为这种组合命名，用已确认、可撤销的操作加以演示，提出从辅导到编排的阶梯式路径，并给出一个评估议程。

paragraphs.en: The Meta Chat is a separate chat in Chat AI [ 7 ] . It is opened from an AI icon in the sidebar header and reuses the normal chat shell, so it feels like the rest of the application rather than a bolted-on assistant. A banner above the conversation states its two purposes—learning how to use Chat AI and finding past chats and topics—and offers entry points to browse tutorials and use cases, which helps users who do not yet know what to ask. In short, the meta chat is a normal conversation with special routing and special privileges, not a separate service.
paragraphs.zh: Meta 聊天是 Chat AI [ 7 ] 中一个独立的聊天。 它通过侧边栏标题栏中的一个 AI 图标打开，并复用普通的聊天外壳，因此它感觉像是应用程序的其余部分，而不是一个硬加上的助手。 对话上方的一条横幅说明了它的两个用途——学习如何使用 Chat AI 以及查找过去的聊天和话题——并提供了浏览教程和用例的入口，这有助于还不知道该问什么的用户。 简而言之，meta 聊天是一场具有特殊路由和特殊权限的普通对话，而不是一个独立的服务。

paragraphs.en: The meta assistant can access every conversation and read every user-facing setting or control, so it can answer questions about the workspace as a whole rather than about a pre-selected subset. At the metadata level, the client supplies a structured, size-bounded view: conversation identifiers, titles, topics, recency, and compact configuration descriptions; the topic list, current setting and preference values, saved memories, the model catalogue, and the Meta Chat ’s own settings. A bounded context is therefore a packaging choice, not a restriction on what the assistant may access.
paragraphs.zh: 元助手可以访问每一次对话并读取每一个面向用户的设置或控件，因此它能够回答关于整个工作区的问题，而不是关于某个预先选定子集的问题。 在元数据层面，客户端提供一个结构化的、大小受限的视图：对话标识符、标题、主题、最近活跃时间以及紧凑的配置描述；主题列表、当前的设置与偏好值、已保存的记忆、模型目录，以及元聊天自身的设置。 因此，有界上下文是一种打包选择，而不是对智能体可访问内容的限制。

paragraphs.en: At the content level, the client adds short conversation summaries and, when a question needs exact evidence, searches all stored message text locally and adds only the most relevant excerpts, each tied to a citable message. Decision and comparison questions also receive a few recent excerpts. Summaries are generated out of band when a conversation is left, so they can be missing, incomplete, or stale; the prompt tells the model not to invent them.
paragraphs.zh: 在内容层面，客户端会添加简短的对话摘要，并且当问题需要精确证据时，在本地搜索所有已存储的消息文本，只添加最相关的摘录，每条摘录都关联到一条可引用的消息。 决策类和比较类问题也会收到一些近期的摘录。 摘要是在离开对话时带外生成的，因此可能缺失、不完整或过时；提示词会告诉模型不要凭空编造它们。

paragraphs.en: This is a deliberate trade-off. It keeps context cost bounded and exposes less message content than a full-history baseline, but recall is limited: details absent from both summaries and selected excerpts remain invisible, and lexical search depends on wording. The prototype is therefore a hybrid of metadata access, summary and selective message retrieval, and confirmed mutation rather than a hierarchical or semantic retriever.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一种刻意的设计权衡。 它将上下文成本控制在有限范围内，并且比完整历史基线暴露更少的消息内容，但召回能力有限：摘要和所选摘录中都缺失的细节仍然不可见，且词汇检索依赖于措辞。 因此，该原型是元数据访问、摘要与选择性消息检索以及确认式变更的混合体，而非分层式或语义式检索器。

paragraphs.en: The system prompt constrains the assistant in two ways. References must use internal links whose identifiers come only from the supplied context: links to a conversation, an exact message, a topic, a persona, or a settings tab. The renderer recognises these routes and navigates inside the application, scrolling to and briefly highlighting the target. References therefore act as direct routes into the workspace, not mere citations. The assistant must also stay within the supplied context and must not invent conversations, topics, messages, memories, personas, or preference values.
paragraphs.zh: 系统提示词以两种方式约束智能体。 引用必须使用内部链接，其标识符只能来自所提供的上下文：即指向某个对话、某条具体消息、某个主题、某个人设或某个设置页的链接。 渲染器识别这些路径并在应用程序内部导航，滚动至目标位置并短暂高亮显示。 因此，引用充当直接进入工作区的路径，而不仅仅是引注。 智能体还必须局限于所提供的上下文之内，不得虚构对话、主题、消息、记忆、人设或偏好值。

paragraphs.en: The assistant additionally receives a machine-readable catalogue of interface features, each with a description, keywords, and guided-tour steps that target real controls. It can explain a feature in prose and attach a marker that the client turns into an optional step-by-step tour. Feature help is therefore not only textual: it can hand the user over to the relevant part of the interface.
paragraphs.zh: 助手还会收到一份机器可读的界面功能目录，其中每项功能都带有描述、关键词以及指向真实控件的引导游览步骤。 它可以用文字解释某项功能，并附加一个标记，客户端会将该标记转换为可选的分步导览。 因此，功能帮助不仅仅是文字性的：它还可以将用户引导至界面的相关部分。

paragraphs.en: The Meta Chat treats the catalogue as metadata. The assistant neither reads the prompt nor executes the import, so the handoff does not give it control over the definition.

paragraphs.en: This division is deliberate. It gives the user a one-click path from an intent to a configured conversation without exposing an untrusted system prompt to the assistant or letting the model change settings on its own. The cost is that the recommendation is only as good as the catalogue’s metadata: a poorly described persona is hard to find, and a stale entry can promise behaviour it no longer implements.
paragraphs.zh: 这种划分是有意为之的。 它让用户能够一键从意图直达配置好的对话，既不会向助手暴露不可信的系统提示词，也不允许模型自行更改设置。 代价是推荐的质量完全取决于目录的元数据：描述不佳的智能体很难被找到，而过时的条目可能承诺它已不再实现的行为。

paragraphs.en: Because the meta conversation is stored in the same local database as ordinary chats, meta access inherits the client’s local-first model: conversation data stays in the browser, and the hidden meta conversation can be exported and re-imported. At the same time, the meta flow sends titles, topics, summaries, selected excerpts, memories, persona metadata, the model catalogue, and relevant setting and preference values to the configured model endpoint. Metadata is less sensitive than complete messages, but selected excerpts are still message content, and titles, summaries, memories, and settings can reveal a great deal. Starting a persona also fetches its definition from an external repository, a request that should be visible in the interface.
paragraphs.zh: 由于元对话与普通聊天存储在同一个本地数据库中，元访问继承了客户端的本地优先模型：对话数据保留在浏览器中，隐藏的元对话可以导出并重新导入。 与此同时，元流程会将标题、主题、摘要、选定的摘录、记忆、人格元数据、模型目录以及相关的设置和偏好值发送到已配置的模型端点。 元数据的敏感度低于完整消息，但选定的摘录仍然属于消息内容，而且标题、摘要、记忆和设置可能泄露大量信息。 启动人格时还会从外部仓库获取其定义，这类请求应在界面上可见。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 separates capabilities that are often conflated in discussions of “chat with your app”. Each level adds power and risk. The ladder is not specific to chat: it applies to any stateful application that exposes a workspace model and a capability layer. It assumes, however, an application with a bounded purpose and a host that enforces the capability layer from outside the assistant; Section 4.6 relaxes both assumptions for general-purpose agentic harnesses. The key boundary is mutation: levels 1–3 read, explain, and navigate, whereas level 4 is the first level that changes workspace state through the assistant, including settings and preferences. Level 5 composes such changes. Within the read-only levels, level 2 stays at metadata about conversations, whereas level 3 crosses into conversation content, first through summaries and then through exact message spans. A user-invoked handoff, such as clicking a recommended persona, is a boundary case: it creates a new chat, but the assistant only retrieves and links, and the user performs the import. The guardrail contracts in Section 6.4 apply at every level: evidence and target validation for levels 1–2, provenance and scope for level 3, and confirmation, reversibility, and audit for levels 4–5. The implemented prototype now covers levels 1–3 and a substantial part of level 4: it searches message text with citations and performs confirmed, reversible changes to chats, settings, and memories. Level 5 remains future work, although the prototype can already group several proposed changes into one confirmation card and apply a setting to all chats.
paragraphs.zh: 表 2 区分了在“与你的应用对话”的讨论中经常被混淆的各项能力。 每一级都带来更强的能力和更大的风险。 这个阶梯并不局限于对话：它适用于任何暴露工作区模型和能力层的有状态应用。 但它假设应用具有有界的目标，并且由宿主从智能体之外强制执行能力层；第 4.6 节将放宽对通用智能体框架的这两项假设。 关键的界限是变更：第 1–3 级进行读取、解释和导航，而第 4 级是第一个通过智能体改变工作区状态的级别，包括设置和偏好。 第 5 级则组合这类变更。 在只读级别中，第 2 级停留在对话的元数据层面，而第 3 级则跨入对话内容，先是摘要，然后是精确的消息片段。 用户发起的移交，例如点击推荐的角色，是一个边界情形：它会创建新的对话，但智能体只进行检索和关联，导入由用户完成。 第 6.4 节中的防护栏契约适用于每一级：第 1–2 级需要证据和目标验证，第 3 级需要来源和范围控制，第 4–5 级需要确认、可逆性和审计。 已实现的原型目前覆盖第 1–3 级以及第 4 级的相当一部分：它能带引用地搜索消息文本，并对对话、设置和记忆执行经确认且可逆的变更。 第 5 级仍是未来工作，尽管原型已经能够将多个提议的变更合并到一张确认卡片中，并将一项设置应用到所有对话。

paragraphs.en: Feature tutoring is the lowest-risk form of meta access and the one most directly implemented. The assistant explains where a control is, what it does, and in what order to use it. The guided-tour mechanism closes the loop between explanation and interface by highlighting the relevant element. The tutorial library extends the same mechanism from on-demand help to browsable instruction: users can see which tours exist and start one without first formulating a question. This addresses a persistent problem in feature-rich applications: users do not know what they do not know. A chat that can answer “what can I do here?” lowers the cost of discovery without requiring the user to leave the conversation. Figure 1 shows the browsable tutorial entry point that implements this level.
paragraphs.zh: 功能辅导是元访问中风险最低的形式，也是最容易直接实现的一种。 智能体会解释某个控件在哪里、它有什么作用，以及应该以什么顺序使用。 引导游览机制通过高亮相关元素，在讲解与界面之间形成了闭环。 教程库将同一机制从按需帮助扩展为可浏览的指导：用户可以看到有哪些导览，并在不先提出问题的情况下启动一个导览。 这解决了功能丰富的应用中一个长期存在的问题：用户不知道自己不知道什么。 能够回答「我在这里能做什么？」的聊天功能降低了探索成本，而无需用户离开对话。 图 1 展示了实现这一级别的可浏览教程入口。

sents.en: Feature tutoring is the lowest-risk form of meta access and the one most directly implemented.
sents.zh: 功能辅导是元访问中风险最低的形式，也是最容易直接实现的一种。

sents.en: The assistant explains where a control is, what it does, and in what order to use it.
sents.zh: 智能体会解释某个控件在哪里、它有什么作用，以及应该以什么顺序使用。

sents.en: The guided-tour mechanism closes the loop between explanation and interface by highlighting the relevant element.
sents.zh: 引导游览机制通过高亮相关元素，在讲解与界面之间形成了闭环。

sents.en: The tutorial library extends the same mechanism from on-demand help to browsable instruction: users can see which tours exist and start one without first formulating a question.
sents.zh: 教程库将同一机制从按需帮助扩展为可浏览的指导：用户可以看到有哪些导览，并在不先提出问题的情况下启动一个导览。

sents.en: This addresses a persistent problem in feature-rich applications: users do not know what they do not know.
sents.zh: 这解决了功能丰富的应用中一个长期存在的问题：用户不知道自己不知道什么。

sents.en: A chat that can answer “what can I do here?” lowers the cost of discovery without requiring the user to leave the conversation.
sents.zh: 能够回答「我在这里能做什么？」的聊天功能降低了探索成本，而无需用户离开对话。

sents.en: Figure 1 shows the browsable tutorial entry point that implements this level.
sents.zh: 图 1 展示了实现这一级别的可浏览教程入口。

paragraphs.en: Level 2 is read-only and stays at metadata about conversations and the interface; it does not read conversation content. Metadata retrieval supports questions about the whole workspace: which conversations exist, their titles and topics, when they were last touched, and where to find them. This is the prototype’s “where is my food-order chat?” use case. The answer is useful only if it is grounded and actionable: the assistant must cite a real conversation or topic and provide a link that navigates to it. Grounding turns a plausible-sounding answer into a verifiable one, and the navigation link turns retrieval into a one-click outcome. The prototype also links to settings and reads the current values behind any control, so a preference or configuration question can be answered in the conversation without opening the panel. These are still read-only moves: the assistant opens a view or reports a value, but the user makes the change. Figure 5 shows a metadata answer that links both the conversation and its surrounding topic.
paragraphs.zh: 级别 2 是只读的，仅停留在对话与界面的元数据层面，不会读取对话内容。 元数据检索支持关于整个工作区的问题：存在哪些对话、它们的标题和主题、最后何时被使用，以及在哪里可以找到它们。 这就是原型的“我的点餐对话在哪里？”用例。 只有当答案是有依据且可操作时才有用：助手必须引用真实的对话或主题，并提供一个可跳转到该处的链接。 有依据使一个听起来合理的答案变成可验证的答案，而导航链接则把检索变成一键即可完成的结果。 原型还会链接到设置并读取任何控件背后的当前值，因此偏好或配置问题可以在对话中得到回答，而无需打开设置面板。 这些仍然是只读操作：智能体会打开一个视图或报告一个值，但由用户来做更改。 图 5 展示了一个同时链接到对话及其所属主题的元数据答案。

paragraphs.en: Persona recommendation sits at the same level but extends retrieval to a catalogue the user did not create. The assistant sees only titles, categories, and descriptions, and recommends an entry when one clearly matches the request. The link it emits is a user-invoked handoff: clicking it imports the full definition and starts a new chat. The assistant does not read the persona prompt, choose the model, or apply the settings itself. This keeps the recommendation separate from the user’s explicit import decision while turning it into a concrete starting point. It also means that persona quality is a retrieval problem: the catalogue must be well described, fresh, and free of duplicate or misleading entries.
paragraphs.zh: 画像推荐处于同一层面，但将检索扩展到了用户并未创建的目录。 智能体只能看到标题、类别和描述，当某个条目明显匹配请求时才会推荐它。 智能体输出的链接是一种由用户触发的交接：点击它会导入完整定义并开启一个新对话。 智能体不会读取画像提示词，不会选择模型，也不会自行应用相关设置。 这使推荐与用户的显式导入决策保持分离，同时将其转化为一个具体的起点。 这也意味着画像质量是一个检索问题：目录必须描述清晰、内容新鲜，并且没有重复或误导性的条目。

paragraphs.en: Metadata retrieval is also a natural fit for a conversational command palette. A user can ask in their own words, in their own language, without knowing the exact title. The assistant can reason over titles, topic names, and recency, and can explain why it chose a result. This is more forgiving than substring search, but also less predictable, which is why citations and links matter.
paragraphs.zh: 元数据检索也非常适合对话式命令面板。 用户可以用自己的话、自己的语言进行提问，无需知道确切的标题。 智能体可以对标题、主题名称和时效性进行推理，并能解释它为什么选择了某个结果。 这比子字符串搜索更宽容，但可预测性也更低，因此引用和链接就显得很重要。

paragraphs.en: Metadata is a lossy index. Some content questions, such as “What did we decide about the budget?” , may be answered from a summary; others, such as “Where was the Fork-Join-Modell discussed?” , need the exact message. Summaries provide a compressed first form of content access, but they may omit the exact statement. The prototype therefore implements message-level retrieval as well: it runs a local lexical search over stored message text using the current user message, adds the most relevant excerpts with conversation and message identifiers to the context, and renders citations that open and highlight the exact message. For decision, action-item, and comparison questions it also adds recent excerpts from the most recent conversations. This extends the prototype beyond summary-only retrieval while keeping context bounded and exposing only selected spans. Figure 7 shows the second kind of query resolving to a chat and two exact-message citations.
paragraphs.zh: 元数据是一种有损索引。 某些内容问题（例如「我们对预算做出了什么决定？」）可以从摘要中得到回答；另一些问题（例如「Fork-Join-Modell 在哪里被讨论过？」）则需要确切的消息。 摘要提供了内容访问的压缩的第一种形式，但它们可能省略确切的表述。 因此，原型还实现了消息级检索：它使用当前用户消息对存储的消息文本运行本地词汇搜索，将最相关的片段连同会话和消息标识符一起添加到上下文中，并渲染可以打开并高亮确切消息的引用。 对于决策、行动项和比较类问题，它还会添加来自最近会话的最新片段。 这使原型超越了仅基于摘要的检索，同时保持上下文有界，并只暴露被选中的片段。 图 7 展示了第二类查询解析到一个会话以及两条确切消息引用的情况。

paragraphs.en: The current implementation is deliberately simpler than the principled design we propose for the next step. It does not yet narrow candidates through a metadata hierarchy, use embeddings or hybrid semantic search, or relax recency truncation for older chats. Those changes would improve recall and make the retrieval depth depend on the question rather than on a single global cap. The implemented path already provides the citation discipline and the clear message-level boundary that such a retriever needs.
paragraphs.zh: 目前的实现有意比我们为下一步提出的原则性设计更简单。 它尚未通过元数据层级来筛选候选，未使用嵌入或混合语义搜索，也未对较旧的聊天放宽近期性截断。 这些改进将提升召回率，并使检索深度取决于问题本身，而非单一的全局上限。 已实现的路径已经提供了此类检索器所需的引用规范和清晰的消息级边界。

paragraphs.en: Level 4 is the first level that changes workspace state. Unlike the read-only links and preference printouts of level 2, a confirmed action performs a mutation. The prototype implements a first version: it renames or moves a conversation, creates a topic as part of a move, changes global preferences, changes per-chat settings for one or all chats, and adds, edits, deletes, or clears memories. Per-chat settings include the model, temperature, top_p, reasoning effort, memory-mode override, tools, and web-search flags. Settings count as mutations, as do memory changes. Opening the settings panel remains navigation (level 2); changing a value is a mutation (level 4).
paragraphs.zh: 第 4 级是第一个会更改工作区状态的级别。 与第 2 级的只读链接和偏好打印输出不同，确认执行的操作会执行一次变更。 该原型实现了第一版：它可以重命名或移动一个会话，在移动过程中创建主题，更改全局偏好，更改单个或全部聊天的按聊天设置，以及添加、编辑、删除或清空记忆。 按聊天设置包括模型、temperature、top_p、推理努力程度、记忆模式覆盖、工具以及网页搜索开关。 设置更改被视为变更，记忆的更改也是如此。 打开设置面板仍属于导航（第 2 级）；修改某个值则是变更（第 4 级）。

paragraphs.en: These actions are expressed as typed, narrowly scoped proposals and validated on the client. The assistant never executes them directly. Instead, the card below the message shows the target object, the old and new values where available, a warning icon, and an explicit accept action. After applying, a revert action is available only if the current state still matches what was applied; the check prevents overwriting intervening manual edits. This provides confirmation and conditional reversibility. Still missing are a durable audit log, topic rename and deletion, chat deletion and export, and archival operations. Figure 8 shows the read, propose, and confirm cycle for per-chat settings, and Figure 9 shows a workspace-wide model audit that precedes a bulk change.
paragraphs.zh: 这些操作以类型化、作用域狭窄的提议形式表达，并在客户端进行验证。 智能体绝不直接执行这些操作。 相反，消息下方的卡片会显示目标对象、新旧值（在可用的情况下）、警告图标以及一个明确的接受操作。 应用之后，仅当当前状态仍与已应用的内容一致时，才会提供撤销操作；该检查可防止覆盖期间的手动编辑。 这提供了确认机制与有条件的可逆性。 仍然缺失的还有持久化审计日志、主题重命名与删除、聊天删除与导出，以及归档操作。 图 8 展示了针对每个聊天设置的读取、提议和确认循环，图 9 展示了在大批量更改之前进行的工作区级模型审计。

paragraphs.en: Confirmation is not a bureaucratic extra. It protects against the failure mode that makes agentic interfaces frustrating: a confident but wrong action on personal data. A good interaction shows the proposed change, the target object, and the expected effect before execution. For bulk operations, a preview is essential; the prototype lists every proposed change and supports applying the same per-chat setting to all chats.
paragraphs.zh: 确认不是官僚式的多余步骤。 它防止的是让智能体界面令人沮丧的那种失败模式：对个人数据做出自信却错误的行为。 良好的交互会在执行之前展示拟议的更改、目标对象和预期效果。 对于批量操作，预览必不可少；该原型列出每一项拟议的更改，并支持将相同的单聊设置应用到所有聊天。

paragraphs.en: At the top of the ladder, the assistant composes multiple actions: “group the chats from last week by project, rename generic titles, and archive the duplicates.” This is the most powerful and the most dangerous level. It requires planning, intermediate verification, the ability to stop and ask, and a strong notion of scope. The prototype already lets the model place several typed changes—chat moves, renames, settings, and memories—into one confirmation card, and it can apply a per-chat setting to all chats. That is only composition with a single confirmation step, not full orchestration. We expect level 5 to be appropriate only with permissioning, dry runs, and the ability to review a diff of proposed changes.
paragraphs.zh: 在阶梯的顶端，智能体（助手）可以组合多个操作：“把上周的聊天按项目分组，重命名那些泛泛的标题，并归档重复项。”这是最强大也是最危险的层级。 它需要规划能力、中间验证、能够停下来询问，以及对范围的清晰把握。 原型已经允许模型把多个有类型的更改——聊天移动、重命名、设置和记忆——放入一张确认卡片中，并且可以将针对单个聊天的设置应用到所有聊天。 这只是带有单次确认步骤的组合，还不是完整的编排。 我们预期第 5 级只有在具备权限控制、试运行以及能够审阅拟议更改的差异（diff）时才是合适的。

sents.en: At the top of the ladder, the assistant composes multiple actions: “group the chats from last week by project, rename generic titles, and archive the duplicates.” This is the most powerful and the most dangerous level.
sents.zh: 在阶梯的顶端，智能体（助手）可以组合多个操作：“把上周的聊天按项目分组，重命名那些泛泛的标题，并归档重复项。”这是最强大也是最危险的层级。

sents.en: It requires planning, intermediate verification, the ability to stop and ask, and a strong notion of scope.
sents.zh: 它需要规划能力、中间验证、能够停下来询问，以及对范围的清晰把握。

sents.en: The prototype already lets the model place several typed changes—chat moves, renames, settings, and memories—into one confirmation card, and it can apply a per-chat setting to all chats.
sents.zh: 原型已经允许模型把多个有类型的更改——聊天移动、重命名、设置和记忆——放入一张确认卡片中，并且可以将针对单个聊天的设置应用到所有聊天。

sents.en: That is only composition with a single confirmation step, not full orchestration.
sents.zh: 这只是带有单次确认步骤的组合，还不是完整的编排。

sents.zh: 我们预期第 5 级只有在具备权限控制、试运行以及能够审阅拟议更改的差异（diff）时才是合适的。

paragraphs.en: The ladder assumes an application with a bounded purpose and a host that enforces the capability layer from outside the assistant. A general-purpose agentic harness such as OpenCode [ 17 ] violates both assumptions. It is not a chat client with a fixed workspace: it is a runtime for arbitrary tasks, repositories, models, and tools. Its state is the task environment, and its own configuration—model and prompt selection, tool and server registries, permission and sandbox policy, hooks, subagents, and project instructions—is a control plane rather than a purpose-specific application metamodel.
paragraphs.zh: 该阶梯模型假设应用具有有界的目的，并且由宿主从助手外部强制实施能力层。 诸如 OpenCode [ 17 ] 这样的通用智能体框架同时违反了这两个假设。 它不是一个具有固定工作区的聊天客户端：它是一个面向任意任务、代码仓库、模型和工具的运行时。 它的状态就是任务环境，而其自身配置——模型与提示词选择、工具与服务器注册表、权限与沙箱策略、钩子、子智能体以及项目指令——是一个控制平面，而非面向特定目的的应用元模型。

sents.zh: 该阶梯模型假设应用具有有界的目的，并且由宿主从助手外部强制实施能力层。

sents.en: A general-purpose agentic harness such as OpenCode [ 17 ] violates both assumptions.

paragraphs.en: Mechanically, self-configuration still traverses the ladder: reading configuration, logs, or session metadata is level 2 or 3; a single setting change is level 4; and composing persistent changes across model, tools, and permissions is level 5. The risk is not captured by the autonomy level alone. We therefore distinguish the target of a change from the level of autonomy. A behavioural setting (verbosity or temperature) is ordinary level 4; a state setting (memory or retention) carries level-3 privacy consequences; a capability setting (tools, servers, plugins, or network access) changes what the assistant can do in future; and an authority setting (permissions, approval policy, sandbox, or hooks) changes who can approve actions and what can be observed. The last two are control-plane mutations, and the last is self-escalation.
paragraphs.zh: 从机制上讲，自我配置仍然要爬完这个阶梯：读取配置、日志或会话元数据属于第 2 或第 3 级；修改单个设置属于第 4 级；而组合跨模型、工具和权限的持久性变更则属于第 5 级。 风险并不能仅由自主性等级来刻画。 因此，我们把变更的目标与自主性的等级区分开来。 行为类设置（冗长度或温度）是普通的第 4 级；状态类设置（记忆或保留）带有第 3 级的隐私后果；能力类设置（工具、服务器、插件或网络访问）会改变智能体未来能做什么；权限类设置（权限、审批策略、沙箱或钩子）会改变谁能批准操作以及能观察到什么。 最后两类属于控制面变更，而最后一类是自我提权。

paragraphs.en: We call confirmed self-configuration level 4S (self) and persistent, autonomous reconfiguration level 5S . These labels combine a level with a target; they are not new rungs on the same axis. Level 4S with a behavioural target is mild, whereas level 4S with an authority target is more dangerous than many level-5 workspace actions. A harness must not let the assistant approve its own authority changes at any level. Runtime enforcement frameworks such as ClawGuard [ 55 ] locate the check at the tool-call boundary, which is where a harness must enforce capability and authority scopes. The assistant may propose a diff, but a separate policy layer or a human should apply it out of band after showing the effect on current and future sessions. Authority, capability, and persistent settings need an immutable audit trail, scoped activation, a dry run, and clear rollback semantics; changes that take effect only after a restart must say so.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将已确认的自我配置称为 4S 级（self，自我），将持续的自主式重配置称为 5S 级。 这些标签将等级与目标相结合；它们并不是同一坐标轴上的新梯级。 以行为为目标的 4S 级较为温和，而以权限为目标的 4S 级比许多 5 级工作区操作更危险。 运行框架（harness）在任何等级下都不得允许智能体批准自身的权限变更。 诸如 ClawGuard [55] 之类的运行时强制框架将检查定位在工具调用边界，而这正是运行框架必须强制执行能力与权限范围的地方。 智能体可以提出差异（diff），但应由独立的策略层或人工在展示其对当前和未来会话的影响之后，带外（out of band）应用该差异。 权限、能力和持久化设置需要不可变的审计追踪、限定范围的激活、试运行（dry run）以及清晰的回滚语义；仅在重启后才生效的变更必须明确说明这一点。

paragraphs.en: A further complication is that harness configuration often lives in ordinary files. If the harness also exposes generic file-editing or shell tools, the assistant can change its settings without using a typed capability at all, bypassing the confirmation, validation, and audit that the ladder assumes. The classification therefore has to follow the capability actually used, not the file path or the setting’s name. The safe design is to keep the authority and capability control plane outside the agent’s writable scope, or to treat edits to it as a distinct, strongly guarded capability.
paragraphs.zh: 更复杂的一点是，harness 的配置通常存放在普通文件中。 如果 harness 还暴露了通用的文件编辑或 shell 工具，智能体就可以在不使用任何类型化能力的情况下更改自己的设置，从而绕过这一阶梯设计所预设的确认、校验和审计。 因此，分类必须依据实际使用的能力，而不是文件路径或设置的名称。 安全的做法是把权限与能力的控制平面置于智能体可写范围之外，或者把对它的编辑视为一种独特的、受到严格防护的能力。

paragraphs.en: Users often do not have a query; they have an intention. Classical search assumes the user can express a keyword. Conversational meta access lets the user describe the memory instead: “the chat where we compared two travel options” . The assistant can map that description onto titles, summaries, and topics, ask a clarifying question if needed, and return a small set of candidates with links. This is retrieval as a dialogue rather than a one-shot query, and it can recover from ambiguity instead of returning an empty result page.
paragraphs.zh: 用户常常并没有一个查询，他们有的是一个意图。 经典搜索假设用户能够表达出关键词。 对话式元访问则让用户改为描述记忆：“我们比较两个旅行方案的那次聊天”。 智能体可以将该描述映射到标题、摘要和主题上，必要时提出一个澄清性问题，并返回一小组带有链接的候选结果。 这是作为对话而非一次性查询的检索，它能够从歧义中恢复，而不是返回一个空结果页面。

paragraphs.en: A chat client with hundreds of conversations is a spatial interface: users remember where things were. Meta access can answer orientation questions (“what did I work on last week?”, “which topics are unused?”) and navigate directly to a target. It can also explain the organisation of the workspace, which is otherwise implicit in a sidebar tree. This is particularly valuable for infrequent users, who must re-learn the layout each time they return.
paragraphs.zh: 一个拥有数百个会话的聊天客户端是一种空间界面：用户记得东西在哪里。 元数据访问可以回答定位问题（“我上周做了什么？”、“哪些话题未被使用？”）并直接导航到目标。 它还可以解释工作区的组织结构，而这种结构在侧边栏树中通常是隐含的。 这对不常使用的用户尤其有价值，他们每次回来都必须重新学习布局。

paragraphs.en: Feature-rich applications accumulate controls that most users never touch. A meta assistant that knows the feature catalogue can act as an always-available onboarding layer: it explains, demonstrates, and guides. Because the catalogue is data rather than hard-coded prose, it can evolve with the interface, and because the guidance is anchored to real elements, it can be verified by running the tour. The prototype’s tutorial library and feature guides are a concrete instance of this idea: the user can browse what is available or ask for help in natural language. The persona catalogue extends discovery from features to configurations: a user who describes a goal can be handed a ready-made setup instead of being told which controls to change.
paragraphs.zh: 功能丰富的应用会积累大量大多数用户从未使用过的控件。 一个了解功能目录的元智能体可以充当随时可用的引导层：它负责解释、演示和指引。 由于目录是数据而非硬编码的文案，它可以随界面一同演进；又由于引导锚定在真实元素上，可以通过运行导览来验证。 该原型的教程库和功能指南正是这一理念的具体实例：用户可以浏览可用内容，或用自然语言寻求帮助。 人物设定目录将发现范围从功能扩展到了配置：描述了目标的用户可以直接获得一个现成的设置方案，而不是被告知该修改哪些控件。

paragraphs.en: The most interesting potential is composition. A single request can span retrieval, navigation, and configuration: “Find the chat about the conference, move it to Travel, and switch it to the model with the long context.” A milder form already exists: recommend a persona, then let the user start it with one click. No single screen supports the full sequence. A meta layer can, provided that each step is grounded, permissioned, and visible. Composition is where chat stops being a help window and becomes an interface in its own right.
paragraphs.zh: 最有趣的潜力在于组合。 单个请求可以跨越检索、导航和配置：“找到关于那场会议的聊天，把它移到「旅行」，再切换到具有长上下文的模型。”一种更温和的形式已经存在：推荐一个角色，然后让用户一键启动它。 没有单一的屏幕能支持完整的流程。 一个元层可以做到，前提是每一步都有依据、经过授权并且可见。 组合正是聊天不再只是一个帮助窗口、而成为独立界面的所在。

paragraphs.en: Natural-language access can lower barriers for users who find hierarchical menus, small controls, or dense settings panels difficult. It can also help users who are not fluent in the interface’s language, since the assistant can answer in the user’s language and translate intent into the correct controls.

For a blind user, this is a usable description of the workspace; for a user with a motor impairment, it replaces precise pointing with intent; for a user with a cognitive or language barrier, it can simplify navigation and explain controls in plain language.

paragraphs.en: The prototype already contains the ingredients: tutorials provide readable, step-by-step guidance; metadata and links support orientation; preference readouts avoid hunting through panels; personas lower configuration burden; and confirmed proposals make changes inspectable before they are applied. Latency, error recovery, and the risk of a confident but wrong answer matter more, not less, when the assistant is the user’s primary route into the interface; the textual interface must remain fully usable on its own.

paragraphs.en: The chat client is a convenient first demonstrator, not the limit of the pattern. An IDE can expose its project model, run configurations, and diagnostics; a spreadsheet can expose sheets, ranges, formulas, and chart definitions; a dashboard can expose widgets, filters, and data sources; an operating system can expose files, applications, and settings. These are the applications’ existing internal models, not a new parallel representation; the meta layer exposes them through a common contract. In each case the same three ingredients recur: a workspace model that the assistant can inspect, a capability layer that declares what may be read or changed, and evidence and consent contracts that keep the assistant grounded and the user in control. The chat-specific parts of the prototype, i.e., tutorials, personas, and conversation links, are instances of these ingredients, not the ingredients themselves. We therefore propose that AI-era interfaces should expose such a meta layer as a default part of their architecture, in the same way that they expose an API, a settings model, or an accessibility layer.
paragraphs.zh: 聊天客户端是一个方便的首个演示场景，而非该模式的极限。 IDE 可以暴露其项目模型、运行配置和诊断信息；电子表格可以暴露工作表、区域、公式和图表定义；仪表盘可以暴露组件、过滤器和数据源；操作系统可以暴露文件、应用和设置。 这些是应用已有的内部模型，而不是新的平行表示；元层通过一个统一的契约将它们暴露出来。 在每一种情形中，同样的三个要素反复出现：一个智能体可以查看的工作区模型，一个声明哪些内容可读或可改的能力层，以及让智能体保持有据可依、让用户保持掌控的证据与同意契约。 原型中聊天特有的部分，即教程、角色和对话链接，只是这些要素的实例，而不是要素本身。 因此，我们提出 AI 时代的界面应当把这样的元层作为架构的默认组成部分暴露出来，就像它们暴露 API、设置模型或无障碍层一样。

paragraphs.en: The design should not depend on the chat surface. A portable meta layer needs four pieces: a workspace model, ideally derived from the application’s own metamodel; a typed capability registry; an evidence and consent contract; and an evaluation surface. Applications can implement these pieces with different data models, transports, and vocabularies; the assistant should see the same shape. Standardising the contract would let one assistant work across applications without bespoke integrations, and would let users compare and audit behaviour. The prototype realizes these pieces for a chat client; the same pieces apply to other applications.
paragraphs.zh: 设计不应依赖于聊天界面。 可移植的元层需要四个部分：一个工作区模型（理想情况下应派生自应用自身的元模型）；一个类型化的能力注册表；一个证据与同意契约；以及一个评估界面。 各应用可以用不同的数据模型、传输方式和词汇表来实现这些部分；智能体应看到相同的形态。 将该契约标准化后，同一个智能体即可跨应用工作而无需定制集成，用户也能比较和审计其行为。 该原型为一个聊天客户端实现了这些部分；同样的部分也适用于其他应用。

paragraphs.en: An assistant that works across arbitrary applications needs a model of each application, not only a screenshot or a prompt. Most applications already have one. A debugger is the clearest precedent: it exposes internal objects, call stacks, and controlled mutations through a typed interface, without pretending that the program is a flat text buffer. Meta access can generalize the same idea. Instead of inventing a parallel description of the interface, the meta layer should derive its workspace model and capability registry from the application’s existing metamodel—its document model, project model, schema, scene graph, or component tree—and expose a stable, permissioned subset to the assistant. The hard problem is not inventing a metamodel but choosing a minimal, versioned, permissioned view and mapping it consistently across applications.
paragraphs.zh: 一个能在任意应用程序之间工作的助手需要每个应用程序的模型，而不仅仅是截图或提示词。 大多数应用程序其实已经有了这样的模型。 调试器是最清晰的先例：它通过类型化接口暴露内部对象、调用栈和受控变更，而不假装程序只是一个扁平的文本缓冲区。 元访问可以将同样的思路推广开来。 与其另起炉灶为界面编造一套平行描述，元层应当从应用程序已有的元模型——其文档模型、项目模型、模式、场景图或组件树——推导出它的工作区模型与能力注册表，并向智能体暴露一个稳定且受权限约束的子集。 难题不在于发明一个元模型，而在于选择一个最小化、有版本管理、受权限约束的视图，并在各应用程序之间一致地映射它。

paragraphs.en: A general-purpose agentic harness has no single application metamodel to reuse. Its workspace model is task-relative, and its stable part is the capability registry and the policy that governs it. For such systems, the portable contract should expose three layers instead: the task context (repository, files, and running processes), the available capabilities and their scopes, and the harness configuration that determines future capabilities. The first layer is application-like, the second is the capability model described below, and the third is a control plane: it should be readable and proposable, but not self-applied when it touches authority.
paragraphs.zh: 通用型智能体框架没有可复用的单一应用元模型。 其工作区模型是相对于任务的，其稳定部分是能力注册表以及管理它的策略。 对于这类系统，可移植的契约应改为暴露三层：任务上下文（仓库、文件和正在运行的进程）、可用能力及其作用域，以及决定未来能力的框架配置。 第一层类似应用，第二层是下文描述的能力模型，第三层是一个控制平面：它应当可读、可提议，但当涉及权限时不应自行应用。

paragraphs.en: An action-capable meta layer needs an explicit capability model rather than a giant prompt. Each capability should declare its inputs, its target object type, its preconditions, whether it is read-only or mutating, whether it is reversible, and what confirmation it requires. The model’s job is to select and fill capabilities, not to manipulate the DOM. A typed capability layer keeps the assistant honest and makes the same capabilities available to buttons, keyboard shortcuts, and the chat. This follows the tool-use pattern demonstrated by API-calling agents [ 20 , 29 ] . The persona catalogue illustrates the split: reading persona metadata is a retrieval capability, whereas instantiating a persona is a separate, mutating capability that the user confirms by clicking a link.
paragraphs.zh: 一个可执行动作的元层需要显式的能力模型，而不是一个巨大的提示词。 每个能力都应声明其输入、目标对象类型、前置条件、是只读还是可变更、是否可逆，以及需要何种确认。 模型的职责是选择并填充能力，而不是操作 DOM。 一个带类型的能力层能让智能体保持诚实，并使相同的能力可用于按钮、键盘快捷键和聊天。 这遵循了调用 API 的智能体所展示的工具使用模式 [ 20 , 29 ] 。 人设目录说明了这种划分：读取人设元数据是一种检索能力，而实例化人设则是一种单独的、可变更的能力，用户通过点击链接来确认。

paragraphs.en: The guardrails we propose are not content filters. They constrain what the meta layer may claim, cite, disclose, and change. Each capability should declare a contract with six parts: its evidence source, its permitted scope, how its target is validated, what it discloses, what confirmation it requires, and what it does when the contract cannot be satisfied. The contract is enforced by the client and the capability layer, not only by the system prompt. A prompt can ask the model not to invent an identifier; only code can reject a missing ID, a stale deep link, an out-of-scope chat, or an unconfirmed mutation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出的防护机制并非内容过滤器。 它们约束的是元层可以声称什么、引用什么、披露什么以及修改什么。 每个能力都应声明一份包含六个部分的契约：其证据来源、其允许的范围、其目标如何验证、它披露什么、它需要什么确认，以及当契约无法满足时它会做什么。 这份契约由客户端和能力层来执行，而不仅仅由系统提示词执行。 提示词可以要求模型不要编造标识符；只有代码才能拒绝缺失的 ID、过期的深链、超出范围的聊天或未经确认的变更。

sents.zh: 我们提出的防护机制并非内容过滤器。

sents.zh: 它们约束的是元层可以声称什么、引用什么、披露什么以及修改什么。

sents.en: Each capability should declare a contract with six parts: its evidence source, its permitted scope, how its target is validated, what it discloses, what confirmation it requires, and what it does when the contract cannot be satisfied.
sents.zh: 每个能力都应声明一份包含六个部分的契约：其证据来源、其允许的范围、其目标如何验证、它披露什么、它需要什么确认，以及当契约无法满足时它会做什么。

sents.en: The contract is enforced by the client and the capability layer, not only by the system prompt.
sents.zh: 这份契约由客户端和能力层来执行，而不仅仅由系统提示词执行。

sents.en: A prompt can ask the model not to invent an identifier; only code can reject a missing ID, a stale deep link, an out-of-scope chat, or an unconfirmed mutation.
sents.zh: 提示词可以要求模型不要编造标识符；只有代码才能拒绝缺失的 ID、过期的深链、超出范围的聊天或未经确认的变更。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 maps these contracts onto the main capability families. For message-level search, the critical boundary is evidence: the answer must distinguish a summary from a message span, cite exact messages, and respect the same permissions as the workspace. For navigation and tutoring, the critical boundary is the target: the assistant must resolve the live interface state, validate routes, highlight real controls, and explain unavailability instead of inventing a setting. Persona recommendation adds a supply-chain boundary: only catalogue metadata enters the meta context, and the definition stays untrusted until the user starts it. Preference reads should be timestamped snapshots of actual values, and mutations should require preview, confirmation, and undo.

paragraphs.en: The contracts scale with the ladder. Levels 1–2 need evidence and target validation. Level 3 adds provenance and scope controls over message content. Levels 4–5 add preview, confirmation, reversibility, and audit. A multi-step plan at level 5 should be checked against the contracts at every step, not only at the end, and a failed contract should produce an explicit refusal or a request for clarification rather than a confident fallback.

paragraphs.en: The context strategy should be tiered. Level 2 uses the metadata catalogue, the persona catalogue, and setting and preference values. Level 3 adds summaries and a searchable index over message text and attachments, with metadata as a pre-filter. This mirrors the retrieve-then-generate pattern of retrieval-augmented generation [ 13 , 10 ] . Freshness should be visible: the assistant should know when a summary was generated and should prefer message-level evidence when the summary is old or the question is specific. Size bounds should be explained rather than silent; if a query needs material outside the assembled view, the assistant should say so and retrieve further.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文策略应当分层。 第 2 层使用元数据目录、角色目录以及设置与偏好值。 第 3 层在此基础上增加摘要，并针对消息文本和附件建立可搜索的索引，元数据作为预过滤条件。 这与检索增强生成中的「先检索后生成」模式相呼应 [ 13 , 10 ] 。 新鲜度应当可见：智能体应当知道摘要是何时生成的，并且当摘要过旧或问题较为具体时，应优先使用消息层面的证据。 大小限制应当加以说明而非默默处理；如果查询需要已组装视图之外的内容，智能体应当说明这一点并进一步检索。

paragraphs.en: Every factual claim about the workspace should be traceable. Links to conversations are the minimal form of citation. Persona recommendations should name only catalogue entries and link to their definitions so the user can inspect the source before starting. Message-level retrieval should cite message identifiers or snippets. Preference answers should name the settings section and, where possible, link to it so the user can verify the value. When evidence is missing, the assistant should say so and offer a next step (search full text, broaden the time range, or ask the user). Calibrated uncertainty is more useful than confident fabrication, especially when the user is about to act on the answer [ 2 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 关于工作区的每一项事实性陈述都应可追溯。 指向对话的链接是最小形式的引用。 人设推荐应只提及目录条目并链接到其定义，以便用户在开始前查看来源。 消息级检索应引用消息标识符或片段。 偏好类回答应指明设置分区，并尽可能链接到该分区，以便用户核实数值。 当证据缺失时，智能体应如实说明并提供下一步建议（搜索全文、扩大时间范围，或询问用户）。 经过校准的不确定性比自信的虚构更有用，尤其是当用户即将依据答案采取行动时 [ 2 ]。

paragraphs.en: Actions should follow a principle of least authority. Reading metadata, reading message content, reading preference values, and mutating state are distinct permissions. Bulk actions should require stronger confirmation than single-object actions. Destructive actions should be reversible or explicitly confirmed. The assistant should show a preview of the change and a diff where applicable, and the user should be able to undo. These are standard software-safety principles applied to a new kind of actor [ 12 , 2 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 操作应遵循最小权限原则。 读取元数据、读取消息内容、读取偏好设置值以及修改状态是彼此不同的权限。 批量操作应比单对象操作要求更强的确认。 破坏性操作应可撤销，或经过明确确认。 智能体应在适用时展示变更预览和差异对比，并且用户应能够撤销。 这些是应用于一种新型行为主体的标准软件安全原则 [ 12 , 2 ] 。

paragraphs.en: A meta assistant reads content the user did not write, including model output, imported chats, and document text. That content is untrusted and may contain instructions aimed at the assistant. If the assistant can act, injected text could try to trigger actions. Defences include treating retrieved content as data rather than instructions, separating the instruction channel from the content channel, restricting tools by scope, requiring confirmation for mutations, and never allowing retrieved text to expand the assistant’s permissions [ 21 , 11 , 5 ] . Personas add a second boundary: their definitions are third-party content and their system prompts can contain instructions. Keeping those prompts out of the meta assistant’s context, and importing them only in a separate user-started chat, prevents a persona from steering the meta layer that recommends it.
paragraphs.zh: 元智能体会读取用户未撰写的内容，包括模型输出、导入的对话记录以及文档文本。 这些内容是不可信的，可能包含针对智能体的指令。 如果智能体能够执行操作，注入的文本可能会试图触发这些操作。 防御措施包括：将检索到的内容视为数据而非指令、将指令通道与内容通道分离、按范围限制工具、对变更操作要求确认，以及绝不允许检索到的文本扩展智能体的权限 [ 21 , 11 , 5 ] 。 角色设定增加了第二重边界：其定义属于第三方内容，其系统提示词也可能包含指令。 将这些提示词排除在元智能体的上下文之外，并且仅在用户单独发起的对话中导入它们，可防止角色设定操纵推荐该角色设定的元层。

paragraphs.en: Sending metadata, settings, and preference values to a model endpoint is a real disclosure. Local-first designs can keep more processing on the client, and deployments should make the boundary explicit. Memories deserve particular care because they are curated personal facts rather than incidental text. Persona titles and descriptions also leave the machine, and starting a persona fetches its definition from an external repository, so the interface should distinguish local data from catalogue traffic.
paragraphs.zh: 将元数据、设置和偏好值发送到模型端点是一种真实的披露。 本地优先的设计可以将更多处理保留在客户端，部署时应明确界定这一边界。 记忆值得特别关注，因为它们是经过整理的个人事实，而非偶然产生的文本。 人设标题和描述同样会离开本机，而且启动人设时会从外部仓库获取其定义，因此界面应当区分本地数据与目录流量。

paragraphs.en: A shared persona repository is convenient but introduces supply-chain risk. Titles and descriptions can be stale, duplicated, or deliberately misleading; a definition can specify an unexpected model or sampling parameters, and its system prompt may contain instructions that conflict with the host application. The meta assistant should recommend only catalogue metadata, the start action should show the persona’s source and configuration, and imported definitions should be treated as untrusted content. Ranking and freshness signals are part of the retrieval problem, not just a presentation detail.
paragraphs.zh: 共享的智能体人设仓库虽然方便，但会引入供应链风险。 标题和描述可能过时、重复或故意误导；定义可能指定意外的模型或采样参数，其系统提示词可能包含与宿主应用相冲突的指令。 元助手应只推荐目录元数据，启动操作应显示该智能体人设的来源和配置，导入的定义应被视为不可信内容。 排序与新鲜度信号属于检索问题的一部分，而不仅仅是展示细节。
