paragraphs.en: If every application invents its own meta layer, assistants will remain bespoke integrations. A common capability description, permission model, and audit format would make meta access portable, but it also raises cross-application questions: what happens when one request spans an IDE, a browser, and a chat client, and which application owns consent? These are open design and governance problems, not only engineering details.
paragraphs.zh: 如果每个应用都发明自己的元层，智能体将仍然是定制化的集成。 一套通用的能力描述、权限模型和审计格式将使元访问具有可移植性，但也带来了跨应用的问题：当一个请求横跨 IDE、浏览器和聊天客户端时会发生什么，以及哪个应用拥有同意权？ 这些是开放的设计与治理问题，而不仅仅是工程细节。

sents.en: If every application invents its own meta layer, assistants will remain bespoke integrations.
sents.zh: 如果每个应用都发明自己的元层，智能体将仍然是定制化的集成。

sents.en: A common capability description, permission model, and audit format would make meta access portable, but it also raises cross-application questions: what happens when one request spans an IDE, a browser, and a chat client, and which application owns consent?
sents.zh: 一套通用的能力描述、权限模型和审计格式将使元访问具有可移植性，但也带来了跨应用的问题：当一个请求横跨 IDE、浏览器和聊天客户端时会发生什么，以及哪个应用拥有同意权？

sents.en: These are open design and governance problems, not only engineering details.
sents.zh: 这些是开放的设计与治理问题，而不仅仅是工程细节。

paragraphs.en: Reusing internal application models exposes details that may be unstable, implementation-specific, or sensitive. A debugger-like interface must define which internals are stable enough to expose, how to version them, and how to avoid leaking secrets or bypassing application permissions. Coupling the assistant to internal models also creates maintenance work as applications evolve.
paragraphs.zh: 复用内部应用模型会暴露可能不稳定的、特定于实现的或敏感的细节。 一个类似调试器的界面必须定义哪些内部结构足够稳定可以暴露、如何为它们做版本管理，以及如何避免泄露机密或绕过应用权限。 将智能体耦合到内部模型还会随着应用的演进而产生维护工作。

sents.en: Reusing internal application models exposes details that may be unstable, implementation-specific, or sensitive.
sents.zh: 复用内部应用模型会暴露可能不稳定的、特定于实现的或敏感的细节。

sents.en: A debugger-like interface must define which internals are stable enough to expose, how to version them, and how to avoid leaking secrets or bypassing application permissions.
sents.zh: 一个类似调试器的界面必须定义哪些内部结构足够稳定可以暴露、如何为它们做版本管理，以及如何避免泄露机密或绕过应用权限。

sents.en: Coupling the assistant to internal models also creates maintenance work as applications evolve.
sents.zh: 将智能体耦合到内部模型还会随着应用的演进而产生维护工作。

paragraphs.en: A general-purpose harness such as OpenCode [ 17 ] can change its own model, tools, prompts, permissions, and hooks. If it can do so through a generic file or shell tool, it can bypass a typed setting capability entirely. Changes to authority or capability can persist across sessions, alter what the assistant is allowed to do, and propagate to subagents; confirmation by the same assistant is not a meaningful control. The policy layer must sit outside the assistant’s writable scope, changes that touch authority must be approved out of band and audited, and activation should be explicit, preferably with a restart and a rollback path.
paragraphs.zh: 像 OpenCode [ 17 ] 这样的通用框架可以更改自身的模型、工具、提示词、权限和钩子。 如果它能通过通用文件工具或 shell 工具做到这一点，就可以完全绕过带类型约束的设置能力。 对权限或能力的更改可以跨会话持久化、改变智能体被允许执行的操作，并传播到子智能体；由同一个智能体进行确认并不是有效的控制手段。 策略层必须位于智能体可写范围之外，涉及权限的更改必须通过带外方式批准并接受审计，且激活应当是显式的，最好伴随重启和回滚路径。

sents.en: A general-purpose harness such as OpenCode [ 17 ] can change its own model, tools, prompts, permissions, and hooks.
sents.zh: 像 OpenCode [ 17 ] 这样的通用框架可以更改自身的模型、工具、提示词、权限和钩子。

sents.en: If it can do so through a generic file or shell tool, it can bypass a typed setting capability entirely.
sents.zh: 如果它能通过通用文件工具或 shell 工具做到这一点，就可以完全绕过带类型约束的设置能力。

sents.en: Changes to authority or capability can persist across sessions, alter what the assistant is allowed to do, and propagate to subagents; confirmation by the same assistant is not a meaningful control.
sents.zh: 对权限或能力的更改可以跨会话持久化、改变智能体被允许执行的操作，并传播到子智能体；由同一个智能体进行确认并不是有效的控制手段。

sents.en: The policy layer must sit outside the assistant’s writable scope, changes that touch authority must be approved out of band and audited, and activation should be explicit, preferably with a restart and a rollback path.
sents.zh: 策略层必须位于智能体可写范围之外，涉及权限的更改必须通过带外方式批准并接受审计，且激活应当是显式的，最好伴随重启和回滚路径。

paragraphs.en: If the chat becomes the primary entry point, users may stop learning the interface and may over-trust its answers. The textual interface must remain first-class, the assistant must be interruptible, and its actions must be visible.
paragraphs.zh: 如果聊天成为主要入口，用户可能停止学习界面本身，并可能过度信任它的回答。 文本界面必须保持一等地位，智能体必须可被中断，其操作必须可见。

sents.en: If the chat becomes the primary entry point, users may stop learning the interface and may over-trust its answers.
sents.zh: 如果聊天成为主要入口，用户可能停止学习界面本身，并可能过度信任它的回答。

sents.en: The textual interface must remain first-class, the assistant must be interruptible, and its actions must be visible.
sents.zh: 文本界面必须保持一等地位，智能体必须可被中断，其操作必须可见。

paragraphs.en: There is no standard benchmark for meta access. We need task suites built from realistic workspaces, with known ground truth for retrieval and navigation, and user studies that measure time, success, and trust. Safety evaluation must include adversarial titles, injected summaries, and ambiguous requests.
paragraphs.zh: 目前没有针对元访问的标准基准。 我们需要基于真实工作区构建的任务集，为检索和导航提供已知真值，并开展衡量时间、成功率与信任度的用户研究。 安全评估必须涵盖对抗性标题、注入式摘要以及含糊不清的请求。

sents.en: There is no standard benchmark for meta access.
sents.zh: 目前没有针对元访问的标准基准。

sents.en: We need task suites built from realistic workspaces, with known ground truth for retrieval and navigation, and user studies that measure time, success, and trust.
sents.zh: 我们需要基于真实工作区构建的任务集，为检索和导航提供已知真值，并开展衡量时间、成功率与信任度的用户研究。

sents.en: Safety evaluation must include adversarial titles, injected summaries, and ambiguous requests.
sents.zh: 安全评估必须涵盖对抗性标题、注入式摘要以及含糊不清的请求。

paragraphs.en: We propose evaluating meta access along five axes: retrieval quality, task success, grounding and calibration, safety and trust, and guardrail effectiveness.
paragraphs.zh: 我们建议从五个维度评估元访问：检索质量、任务成功率、基础性与校准、安全与信任，以及防护栏有效性。

paragraphs.en: Given a natural-language request, does the system return the correct conversation or message, and does it avoid false positives? Useful metrics include recall at small k k , mean reciprocal rank, and reference precision (the fraction of cited identifiers that exist and are relevant). For personas, measure recommendation precision (did the suggested persona fit the stated goal?) and handoff correctness (does the link start the definition it names?).
paragraphs.zh: 给定一个自然语言请求，系统能否返回正确的对话或消息，并且避免误报？ 有用的指标包括小 k 值下的召回率（recall at k）、平均倒数排名（mean reciprocal rank）以及引用精确率（reference precision，即被引用的标识符中确实存在且相关的比例）。 对于角色（persona），应衡量推荐精确率（建议的角色是否符合既定目标？）以及交接正确性（链接是否启动了它所命名的定义？）。

sents.en: Given a natural-language request, does the system return the correct conversation or message, and does it avoid false positives?
sents.zh: 给定一个自然语言请求，系统能否返回正确的对话或消息，并且避免误报？

sents.en: Useful metrics include recall at small k k , mean reciprocal rank, and reference precision (the fraction of cited identifiers that exist and are relevant).
sents.zh: 有用的指标包括小 k 值下的召回率（recall at k）、平均倒数排名（mean reciprocal rank）以及引用精确率（reference precision，即被引用的标识符中确实存在且相关的比例）。

sents.en: For personas, measure recommendation precision (did the suggested persona fit the stated goal?) and handoff correctness (does the link start the definition it names?).
sents.zh: 对于角色（persona），应衡量推荐精确率（建议的角色是否符合既定目标？）以及交接正确性（链接是否启动了它所命名的定义？）。

paragraphs.en: Can the user complete a real task—find a chat, understand a topic, read a preference, find a suitable persona, change a setting—with fewer steps and less time than the baseline interface? Measures include task completion, time on task, number of turns, and abandonment.
paragraphs.zh: 用户能否比基线界面用更少的步骤和更短的时间完成一项真实任务——找到聊天、理解某个话题、阅读偏好设置、找到合适的智能体人设、修改某项设置？ 衡量指标包括任务完成率、任务耗时、对话轮数以及中途放弃率。

sents.en: Can the user complete a real task—find a chat, understand a topic, read a preference, find a suitable persona, change a setting—with fewer steps and less time than the baseline interface?
sents.zh: 用户能否比基线界面用更少的步骤和更短的时间完成一项真实任务——找到聊天、理解某个话题、阅读偏好设置、找到合适的智能体人设、修改某项设置？

sents.en: Measures include task completion, time on task, number of turns, and abandonment.
sents.zh: 衡量指标包括任务完成率、任务耗时、对话轮数以及中途放弃率。

paragraphs.en: When the answer is wrong, does the system say so? We can measure the agreement between stated confidence and correctness, and the rate of fabricated references under missing or stale data. For preference questions, measure whether the printed values match the client’s current settings when the answer is produced. Context construction is part of that outcome: Bousetouane [ 57 ] argues that agents often fail through context failure and proposes criteria for guardrail coverage, instruction consistency, tool-schema quality, grounding sufficiency, and injection hardening. These criteria apply directly to the bounded catalogue and excerpt pipeline of the prototype.
paragraphs.zh: 当答案错误时，系统是否会如此说明？ 我们可以度量所述置信度与正确性之间的一致性，以及在数据缺失或过时情况下虚构引用的发生率。 对于偏好类问题，度量打印出的数值在生成答案时是否与客户端的当前设置相匹配。 上下文构建是这一结果的一部分：Bousetouane [ 57 ] 指出智能体常常因上下文失败而出错，并提出了防护栏覆盖、指令一致性、工具模式质量、接地充分性和注入加固的评估标准。 这些标准可直接应用于原型的有界目录和摘录流水线。

sents.en: When the answer is wrong, does the system say so?
sents.zh: 当答案错误时，系统是否会如此说明？

sents.en: We can measure the agreement between stated confidence and correctness, and the rate of fabricated references under missing or stale data.
sents.zh: 我们可以度量所述置信度与正确性之间的一致性，以及在数据缺失或过时情况下虚构引用的发生率。

sents.en: For preference questions, measure whether the printed values match the client’s current settings when the answer is produced.
sents.zh: 对于偏好类问题，度量打印出的数值在生成答案时是否与客户端的当前设置相匹配。

sents.en: Context construction is part of that outcome: Bousetouane [ 57 ] argues that agents often fail through context failure and proposes criteria for guardrail coverage, instruction consistency, tool-schema quality, grounding sufficiency, and injection hardening.
sents.zh: 上下文构建是这一结果的一部分：Bousetouane [ 57 ] 指出智能体常常因上下文失败而出错，并提出了防护栏覆盖、指令一致性、工具模式质量、接地充分性和注入加固的评估标准。

sents.en: These criteria apply directly to the bounded catalogue and excerpt pipeline of the prototype.
sents.zh: 这些标准可直接应用于原型的有界目录和摘录流水线。

paragraphs.en: For action-capable features, measure the rate of unintended actions, the effectiveness of confirmation, recovery after undo, and susceptibility to prompt injection from retrieved content. For read-only features, measure privacy leakage and user comfort with metadata, message excerpts, and setting and preference disclosure. Persona studies should include adversarial catalogue descriptions and definitions, and check that the meta assistant never receives or repeats the persona’s system prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 对于具备执行操作能力的功能，需测量非预期操作的比率、确认机制的有效性、撤销后的恢复情况，以及来自检索内容的提示词注入易感性。 对于只读功能，需测量隐私泄露情况，以及用户对元数据、消息摘录、设置与偏好披露的接受程度。 人设研究应包含对抗性的目录描述与定义，并检查元助手从不接收或复述该人设的系统提示词。

sents.en: For action-capable features, measure the rate of unintended actions, the effectiveness of confirmation, recovery after undo, and susceptibility to prompt injection from retrieved content.
sents.zh: 对于具备执行操作能力的功能，需测量非预期操作的比率、确认机制的有效性、撤销后的恢复情况，以及来自检索内容的提示词注入易感性。

sents.en: For read-only features, measure privacy leakage and user comfort with metadata, message excerpts, and setting and preference disclosure.
sents.zh: 对于只读功能，需测量隐私泄露情况，以及用户对元数据、消息摘录、设置与偏好披露的接受程度。

sents.en: Persona studies should include adversarial catalogue descriptions and definitions, and check that the meta assistant never receives or repeats the persona’s system prompt.
sents.zh: 人设研究应包含对抗性的目录描述与定义，并检查元助手从不接收或复述该人设的系统提示词。

paragraphs.en: Each contract in Table 3 should be evaluated as a mechanism, not only as a prompt instruction. Measure the unsupported-claim rate, citation correctness, stale-link rate, scope violations, and disclosure accuracy for read-only features. For navigation, measure whether deep links resolve to the intended target and whether unavailable controls are explained correctly. For mutations, measure confirmation compliance, preview accuracy, undo success, and the rate of actions that violate declared permissions. Adversarial tests should attempt to bypass the client-side checks, not only the system prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 表 3 中的每个契约都应作为机制来评估，而不仅仅是作为提示指令。 针对只读功能，测量无依据断言率、引用正确性、失效链接率、范围违规以及披露准确性。 对于导航，测量深层链接是否解析到预期目标，以及不可用的控件是否被正确解释。 对于变更操作，测量确认符合率、预览准确性、撤销成功率，以及违反已声明权限的操作比率。 对抗性测试应尝试绕过客户端检查，而不仅仅是系统提示。

sents.en: Each contract in Table 3 should be evaluated as a mechanism, not only as a prompt instruction.
sents.zh: 表 3 中的每个契约都应作为机制来评估，而不仅仅是作为提示指令。

sents.en: Measure the unsupported-claim rate, citation correctness, stale-link rate, scope violations, and disclosure accuracy for read-only features.
sents.zh: 针对只读功能，测量无依据断言率、引用正确性、失效链接率、范围违规以及披露准确性。

sents.en: For navigation, measure whether deep links resolve to the intended target and whether unavailable controls are explained correctly.
sents.zh: 对于导航，测量深层链接是否解析到预期目标，以及不可用的控件是否被正确解释。

sents.en: For mutations, measure confirmation compliance, preview accuracy, undo success, and the rate of actions that violate declared permissions.
sents.zh: 对于变更操作，测量确认符合率、预览准确性、撤销成功率，以及违反已声明权限的操作比率。

sents.en: Adversarial tests should attempt to bypass the client-side checks, not only the system prompt.
sents.zh: 对抗性测试应尝试绕过客户端检查，而不仅仅是系统提示。

paragraphs.en: For harnesses, measure whether a proposed self-change is scoped, previewed, and reversible; whether it persists across sessions; whether it expands tools, permissions, or approval scope; and whether it propagates to subagents. Test bypasses through generic file and shell tools, not only through the typed setting capability. A useful benchmark is a set of configuration changes whose effects on future capability are known, including changes that look benign in a diff but alter authority after a restart.
paragraphs.zh: 对于测试脚手架，应衡量一个提议的自我修改是否范围受限、可预览且可回滚；是否会跨会话持久化；是否会扩展工具、权限或审批范围；以及是否会传播到子智能体。 通过通用的文件和 shell 工具测试绕过行为，而不仅通过类型化的设置能力来测试。 一个有效的基准是一组配置变更，其对未来能力的影响是已知的，包括那些在 diff 中看似无害、但重启后会改变权限的变更。

sents.en: For harnesses, measure whether a proposed self-change is scoped, previewed, and reversible; whether it persists across sessions; whether it expands tools, permissions, or approval scope; and whether it propagates to subagents.
sents.zh: 对于测试脚手架，应衡量一个提议的自我修改是否范围受限、可预览且可回滚；是否会跨会话持久化；是否会扩展工具、权限或审批范围；以及是否会传播到子智能体。

sents.en: Test bypasses through generic file and shell tools, not only through the typed setting capability.
sents.zh: 通过通用的文件和 shell 工具测试绕过行为，而不仅通过类型化的设置能力来测试。

sents.en: A useful benchmark is a set of configuration changes whose effects on future capability are known, including changes that look benign in a diff but alter authority after a restart.
sents.zh: 一个有效的基准是一组配置变更，其对未来能力的影响是已知的，包括那些在 diff 中看似无害、但重启后会改变权限的变更。

paragraphs.en: Ablations should compare summaries only, full-text retrieval, and hybrid retrieval; different catalogue sizes and recency caps; fresh versus stale summaries and personas; and small versus large models. Longitudinal studies are important because the value of meta access depends on the size and age of a user’s workspace.
paragraphs.zh: 消融实验应比较：仅摘要、全文检索与混合检索；不同的目录规模与新鲜度上限；新鲜与陈旧的摘要及用户画像；以及小型与大型模型。 纵向研究很重要，因为元访问的价值取决于用户工作区的规模与使用时长。

sents.en: Ablations should compare summaries only, full-text retrieval, and hybrid retrieval; different catalogue sizes and recency caps; fresh versus stale summaries and personas; and small versus large models.
sents.zh: 消融实验应比较：仅摘要、全文检索与混合检索；不同的目录规模与新鲜度上限；新鲜与陈旧的摘要及用户画像；以及小型与大型模型。

sents.en: Longitudinal studies are important because the value of meta access depends on the size and age of a user’s workspace.
sents.zh: 纵向研究很重要，因为元访问的价值取决于用户工作区的规模与使用时长。

paragraphs.en: The Meta Chat prototype shows that a chat assistant can already serve as a useful access layer over a chat application: it can explain features, run tutorials, retrieve conversations from metadata, search message text with citations, recommend personas, read current preference values and per-chat settings, ground its answers in links to chats, messages, topics, settings, and personas, and guide users back into the interface. It also performs confirmed, reversible changes to chats, settings, and memories. That covers levels 1–3 and a substantial part of level 4 of the ladder. The prototype already turns the chat from a window onto a workspace into a natural-language entry point to the application; full level-5 orchestration would extend that entry point from confirmed single steps to composed, reviewable workflows.
paragraphs.zh: Meta Chat 原型表明，聊天助手已经可以作为聊天应用之上的一层有用的访问层：它可以解释功能、运行教程、根据元数据检索会话、带引用地搜索消息文本、推荐人设、读取当前偏好值和每会话设置、把回答锚定到会话、消息、话题、设置和人设的链接上，并引导用户回到界面中。 它还能对会话、设置和记忆执行经过确认的、可撤销的更改。 这覆盖了阶梯中的第 1–3 级，以及第 4 级的相当一部分。 该原型已经把聊天从通往工作区的一个窗口变成了应用的自然语言入口；完整的第 5 级编排将把这个入口从经过确认的单步操作扩展到可组合、可审查的工作流。

sents.en: The prototype already turns the chat from a window onto a workspace into a natural-language entry point to the application; full level-5 orchestration would extend that entry point from confirmed single steps to composed, reviewable workflows.
sents.zh: 该原型已经把聊天从通往工作区的一个窗口变成了应用的自然语言入口；完整的第 5 级编排将把这个入口从经过确认的单步操作扩展到可组合、可审查的工作流。

paragraphs.en: Chat is not the only interface for LLMs, and general-purpose agentic harnesses such as OpenCode [ 17 ] are the right choice for many tasks that operate on repositories, shells, or other external environments. Such a harness is not an application with a fixed purpose: its workspace is the task, and its own configuration is a control plane. If it can change that configuration, meta access becomes reflexive, so authority changes need a separate out-of-band boundary rather than a level-4S confirmation by the same assistant. But the chat client remains one durable home for everyday conversation and for the personal workspace that accumulates around it. Meta access is what lets the assistant serve that workspace rather than only the current dialogue.
paragraphs.zh: 聊天并不是大语言模型的唯一交互界面，像 OpenCode [ 17 ] 这样通用的智能体运行框架，才是许多针对代码仓库、Shell 或其他外部环境执行任务的正确选择。 这样的运行框架并不是一个用途固定的应用：它的工作区就是任务本身，而它自身的配置就是一个控制平面。 如果智能体能够修改该配置，元访问就变成自反式的，因此权限变更需要一个独立的带外边界，而不是由同一个智能体进行 4S 级确认。 但聊天客户端仍然是日常对话以及围绕日常对话积累起来的个人工作区的一个持久归宿。 元访问正是让智能体能够服务于这个工作区、而不仅仅是当前对话的关键所在。

paragraphs.en: The opportunity is substantial: conversational search, navigation, onboarding, organisation, and composition in one place. So is the responsibility. The same properties that make meta access powerful—personal data, compressed context, model-generated summaries, and the ability to act—make grounding, privacy, confirmation, and reversibility essential design requirements rather than polish. Guardrails turn those requirements into explicit evidence and authority contracts that the client can enforce and evaluation can test. That is what lets meta access turn the chat interface from a window onto a single conversation into a conversational control layer for the whole workspace, extending chat toward agentic capability without giving up explicit user control. We hope this draft contributes a useful vocabulary and an evaluation agenda for building that future carefully.
paragraphs.zh: 机遇是巨大的：对话式搜索、导航、新手引导、组织与创作皆汇聚于一处。 责任也同样重大。 让元访问（meta access）强大的那些特性——个人数据、压缩上下文、模型生成的摘要，以及执行操作的能力——使得接地、隐私、确认与可逆性成为必不可少的设计要求，而非锦上添花。 护栏将这些要求转化为客户端可以执行、评估可以检验的明确证据与权限契约。 正是这一点，让元访问能够把聊天界面从通往单一对话的窗口，转变为整个工作区的对话式控制层，在不放弃用户明确控制的前提下，将聊天扩展至智能体能力。 我们希望这份草案为审慎地构建这一未来贡献一套有用的术语和一个评估议程。

paragraphs.en: The broader proposal is that meta access should become a default property of AI-era interfaces, not an optional feature of chat clients. The chat prototype shows that the pattern is practical: a workspace model, grounded links, a capability layer, and consent-gated mutations can coexist in a real application. Accessibility is a direct beneficiary: a readable, permissioned model of an application can complement screen readers such as JAWS [ 47 ] and reduce reliance on precise pointing, visual search, or memorised navigation. The next step is to turn each application’s existing metamodel into a stable, permissioned meta-access interface, so the same contract works across IDEs, dashboards, office suites, and operating systems, and to evaluate it as an interface property rather than a single product feature.
paragraphs.zh: 更宏观的主张是：元访问应当成为人工智能时代界面的默认属性，而不是聊天客户端的可选功能。 聊天原型表明这一模式切实可行：工作区模型、有依据的链接、能力层以及经同意把关的变更操作可以在一个真实应用中共存。 无障碍是直接受益者：一个可读的、有权限控制的应用模型可以与 JAWS [ 47 ] 等屏幕阅读器互补，减少对精确指向、视觉搜索或记忆导航的依赖。 下一步是将每个应用现有的元模型转化为稳定、有权限控制的元访问接口，使同一契约能够在集成开发环境、仪表盘、办公套件和操作系统中通用，并将其作为界面的一种属性而非单一产品功能来评估。
